title: NoGigiddy: Remote Data Entry Clerk
description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
URL: https://www.nogigiddy.com/
Job Summary:
We are looking for a Remote Data Entry Clerk to join our team and help us maintain accurate and up-to-date information in our databases and systems. The ideal candidate will have excellent typing skills, an eye for detail, and the ability to work independently. This role is crucial to ensuring that our data is reliable and easily accessible to our team members and clients.
Key Responsibilities:
• Accurately enter data into various databases and systems from source documents within time limits
• Review data for deficiencies or errors, correct any incompatibilities, and check the output
• Verify data by comparing it to source documents
• Update existing data and retrieve data from the database as requested
• Perform regular backups to ensure data preservation
• Organize and maintain files and records for efficient data retrieval
• Collaborate with team members to address any discrepancies or issues with data entry
• Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive information
Requirements:
• Proven experience as a Data Entry Clerk or similar role
• Excellent typing speed and accuracy
• Strong attention to detail and ability to spot errors
• Proficiency in using data entry software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, etc.)
• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
• Strong organizational and time management skills
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
• High school diploma or equivalent; additional qualifications in data management or related fields are a plus
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with remote work and virtual collaboration tools
• Familiarity with data protection regulations and best practices
Compensation:
• Competitive pay rate of $18 to $24 per hour
• Flexible working hours and remote work environment
• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Supportive and collaborative team culture
• Access to the latest technology and tools to perform your job efficiently
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/nogigiddy-remote-data-entry-clerk-7

title: Freelance Copywriter
description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.
The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
About the Role
Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:
Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
Skincare and beauty
Tech and software
Finance and investing
Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
Education
Home improvement
Automobiles and motorcycles
Health and wellness
Medical and clinical fields
Digital marketing
SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing
Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.
Responsibilities
Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team
Qualifications
Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
Portfolio featuring published work preferred
Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred
Compensation
Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.
Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate
This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page
After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate
After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate
Application Process
Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Common Room: Commercial Account Executive
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US
URL: http://commonroom.io
About us
Common Room is the AI GTM Platform that empowers your teams with AI agents built on complete buyer intelligence. We unify every signal across the full buyer journey into one continuously-updated, person-level view—so your team knows exactly who to target and why, what to say, and when to reach out.
GTM teams are drowning in tool sprawl, fragmented data, and AI that doesn't deliver. Common Room replaces your disconnected stack with one platform built for scale and complexity. We bring together data, orchestration, and execution in one system built for orgs of 75-1000+.
We've raised over $50 million from top-tier investors including Greylock, Index, and Madrona, and we're backed by 25+ operators from companies like Figma, Stripe, Airtable, Slack, Notion, Loom, and more.
Why We Need You
We’re looking to take our company to the next level. You’re passionate about sales, excited to use Common Room to sell Common Room, and energized by the challenge of building pipeline, advancing complex deals, and driving real outcomes in an evolving GTM motion.
Our market is rapidly maturing, and customers are looking for partners who can help them transform how they think about go-to-market — moving beyond legacy tools and processes to an integrated, signal-driven approach. To win here, you’ll need grit, resilience, and the ability to influence change in organizations that are used to doing things a certain way.
Rather than just executing sales plays, you’ll help define what success looks like in a new category and continuously refine your approach to unlock growth.
How You’ll Contribute
Hunter mindset + pipeline ownership: Identify, qualify, and develop leads into high-value opportunities through both inbound and self-generated pipeline efforts.
Build deep empathy and trusted relationships with users and executive sponsors to understand needs, priorities, and success criteria.
Own the full sales cycle, including negotiation, procurement, and closing, while maintaining a sharp focus on outcomes.
Engage confidently with technical stakeholders to support onboarding readiness (e.g., data flows, integrations) that unlock customer value.
Partner closely with Solutions Consultants, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders to multi-thread deals and build durable relationships across buyer and executive teams.
Translate learnings from customer conversations into insights for product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy — helping shape the future of how we sell and how the product delivers value.
You’ll Enjoy Being a Member of the Team If You…
You thrive in roles that require ownership, adaptability, and resilience. You're energized by shaping a motion rather than inheriting one.
You’ll fit well if you have:
Experience managing end-to-end SaaS sales cycles for complex products, with bonus points for familiarity with PLG or PLS motions.
A track record of consistent pipeline generation, quota achievement, and growth — showing that you can turn ambiguity into results.
Previous experience at growth-stage companies, ideally with developer tools, data analytics, or value-based selling to sales and marketing organizations.
A solution-based approach to selling and the ability to manage a sales process with both strategic and tactical rigor.
Excellent presentation, listening, organization, and contact management capabilities.
A hands-on approach to technical concepts, able to lead technical discussions internally and externally with stakeholders of all levels.
A strong desire and willingness to learn, adapt, and build as our product and processes evolve over time.
Willingness to travel for customer meetings, events, and team offsites when it meaningfully advances relationships or deals.
In Your First Week, Expect To:
Dive deep into core personas and use cases for Common Room.
Understand how Common Room differentiates from other GTM tools and why our approach is transformative.
Meet your team and cross-functional partners including Marketing, RevOps, Solutions, and Product leadership.
In Your First Month, Expect To:
Become proficient at leading discovery, demos, POCs, and deal closing/negotiation.
Know the Common Room messaging and value props rigorously, and begin adding your own spin to drive results.
Wrap your arms around your existing book of business (use cases, buyer maps, etc.).
Close your first deal(s) in the Commercial segment — with cycle times as short as two weeks.
In Your First Three Months, Expect To:
Be fully ramped with sufficient pipeline coverage to achieve next quarter’s target.
Become a trusted advisor on GTM tools and a resource for customers navigating transformation.
Contribute best practices to the team that increase win rates, velocity, and deal size.
Mentor newer AEs and help shape the hiring profile as we continue building the team.
The compensation range for this position is between $180K - $250K OTE (plus equity) depending on experience.
Our values
Be Customer-centric - We work backwards from the needs of our customers. The crisp articulation of customer value guides our decisions.
Strive for Simplicity - We choose simplicity over complexity whenever possible. We seek to identify and understand the essential quality of what we are building.
Make it Happen - We are quick to take the first step, and prioritize decisiveness over fear of making a mistake. We don’t confuse motion for movement and we measure ourselves on impact over actions.
We’re In this Together - We measure personal success by the success of our customers and teammates. Relationships matter, and the strongest ones are built on the foundations of trust, enablement, and transparency.
Our benefits
Our investment in caring for our employees and their families is a key part of our values and culture at Common Room:
Competitive base compensation with meaningful equity ownership
Health insurance including medical, dental, and vision, HSA and FSA
We pay 100% of your employee premium and 50% of your premium for any dependents
Unlimited Paid Time Off
Paid Company Holidays
Work from home policy including a laptop and support for your home office needs
Monthly Remote Stipend
401(k) self contribution
Paid Family Leave
Opportunity to join a diverse, passionate, and fun team at a pivotal time in the company’s lifecycle
Common Room provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

during beta, yes â both tiers, no credit card, no trial clock. after beta: core is $10/machine/month for monitoring, control, deploy, displays, and cortex on a single site. pro is $50/machine/month (3-machine minimum) and adds the public API, CLI, SDK, webhooks, unlimited sites, and roost â incremental project sync with 1 TB included storage per site. no per-user fees on either.

the agent keeps running. it monitors and auto-recovers processes whether or not it can reach the cloud. when the connection returns, it syncs everything it missed. your machines don't need the internet to run. they've been alone before. they know how to survive.
no inbound ports, no vpn. agents connect outbound over https (port 443) to google's firebase infrastructure. if your network allows general internet access, it just works. locked-down environments may need to whitelist *.googleapis.com and *.firebaseio.com.
cortex is owlette's ai fleet assistant â ask it the questions you ask yourself every day: "which nvidia driver are we running?", "restart the media server on node 3", "what crashed at 3am?" it translates natural language into real commands across your fleet. you bring your own api key (openai, anthropic, or any compatible provider).
roost is owlette's project sync. point it at a folder â a TouchDesigner project, a content drop, a build output â and it ships only the bytes that changed to every machine on the site, atomically: a machine gets the whole new version or stays on the old one, never a half-copied mess. every deploy is versioned, so you can roll back to any of the last 50 for up to 30 days. it's part of the pro tier and includes 1 TB of storage per site ($0.05/GB after that). no more zipping a folder and RDP-ing into ten machines at 2am.
agents connect over tls, credentials are encrypted on-device using a machine-bound key, and oauth tokens are never logged or stored in plaintext. access is managed through firebase auth with optional passkey and two-factor authentication.
yes â owlette is FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (converts to apache 2.0 two years after each release). the full source is on github. fair warning: it requires firebase, a railway (or equivalent) deployment for the web app, and a willingness to blow past your usage limits at 3am debugging support tickets from your neighbor's camper because your furnace broke and it's -10 outside. we won't talk you out of it, but the hosted version exists for a reason.

title: Toggl: Senior Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia
URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join one of our Product Tribes , the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You own your Tribe's direction, prioritization, and outcomes while working hands-on with design and engineering to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl Focus , our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.
The salary for this position is €90,000 annually.
You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.
The Role
As a Senior Product Manager, you own a product area end-to-end: its direction, prioritization, and outcomes. You are accountable not for process, but for clarity, judgment, and results. You work hands-on with design, engineering, and revenue to identify the highest-value opportunities, shape effective solutions, and ship improvements that matter. You act as a player-coach, raising the quality of thinking, decision-making, and execution within your Tribe.
Your main responsibilities will be:
Direction and prioritization
Set clear direction for your Tribe. Define goals, translate company priorities into team focus, and identify the biggest opportunities and risks.
Make strong prioritization calls. Decide what to do and what not to do, sequence work sensibly, and keep low-value work out of the team.
Develop a strong point of view on your product area. Understand users, the market, and the business deeply enough to make tradeoffs and say no clearly, without escalating decisions unnecessarily.
Discovery and solution shaping
Build real understanding of user problems through customer calls, support and sales input, user research, and data.
Shape solutions with design and engineering. Frame problems, compare options and constraints, and keep solutions tied to user and business value.
Hands-on leadership
Lead designers within your Tribe. Guide prototyping, user testing, and UX quality as embedded builders, not through handoffs.
Stay close to the work through execution. Review flows, experiments, metrics, and shipped output. Resolve ambiguity quickly. Help the team converge faster.
Coach your team by sharpening problem framing, improving decision quality, and keeping focus on the highest-value work.
Metrics, learning, and communication
Define success upfront for every initiative with clear OKRs, KPIs, leading indicators, and kill criteria. Measure impact after launch and decide whether to iterate, scale, or roll back.
Participate in roadmap reviews , sharing upcoming priorities with leadership and internal stakeholders and surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.
Explain direction and decisions simply. Keep stakeholders aligned with minimal overhead.
AI as core leverage
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for research, synthesis, analysis, drafting, exploration, and prototyping, and set that expectation across your Tribe. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact.
About You
You will thrive in this role if you:
Have proven product management experience , ideally in B2B SaaS, or have built and shipped products people actually use, whether as a PM, founder, or in another role where you owned product decisions end to end.
Hold an extremely high bar for product quality. You've developed real craft in product development. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't be proud to put your name on.
Have strong product judgment. You develop a clear point of view on your area, make grounded tradeoffs, and say no without needing permission.
Are a problem-first thinker. You start from user needs and business impact, not from solutions or feature lists.
Can define and own outcomes rigorously. You set KPIs, run experiments, interpret data, and make tough calls based on results. You're accountable for whether the work matters, not just whether it gets done.
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You don't wait for perfect information or permission. You make confident decisions, adapt when new insights emerge, and course-correct without drama.
Can pick up a new domain fast. You're comfortable ramping into unfamiliar user segments and becoming the expert your Tribe needs.
Have a strong understanding of product-led growth principles and know how to balance self-serve adoption with sales-assisted motions for larger accounts.
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI for research, analysis, drafting, and prototyping as a core part of how you work, not a side experiment.
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You explain direction and decisions simply, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and articulate customer value without jargon.
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.
Nice to have: experience leading designers as embedded product builders, guiding user research, prototyping, and usability testing as part of an integrated discovery process, not as a separate handoff step.
This Role Is NOT
A meeting organizer, ticket router, or status reporter.
A layer between functions or a process owner whose main contribution is ceremony.
A roadmap administrator who writes detailed specs and manages backlogs rather than deeply understanding users and driving outcomes.
A feature-factory role. If your primary metric is "stories shipped," this isn't the right fit.
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.
The Team
We are a global team of ~100 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.
What's Happening at Toggl
Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl Focus. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence.
Benefits
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays
Unlimited sick leave
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

SHORT ANSWER Translate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.
Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.
They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first
FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.
01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?
A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.
I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.
You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.
02
How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?
Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.
Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.
For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.
fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height
FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free
03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?
Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.
I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.
Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.
04
How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?
A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.
This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.
You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.
Worked example
STAR answer
Before
I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.
After
When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.
How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself
The takeaways
01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.
Questions people ask
Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?
Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.
Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?
No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.
How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?
Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

Summary
We are seeking a Data Scientist to analyze anonymized consumer interaction data and uncover patterns in unstructured language across call center and cross-channel conversations. The primary goal is to identify intent, surface trends, and turn language into structured insights that can inform content strategy and web experiences.
General information
This engagement focuses on a large historical dataset collected over 10 years across consumer information and interaction touchpoints. The data includes call center and cross-channel interactions, with existing KPI reporting around areas such as conflict types and call duration, but limited analysis of the underlying unstructured language.
The data sits in a homegrown database and Azure environment, with an anonymized semantic layer. This role will work closely with a Program Manager supporting the broader effort.

- Analyze anonymized consumer interaction and call center conversation data.
- Review exported conversation data across channels, brands, and interaction types.

- Convert unstructured language into structured insights and usable analysis frameworks.
- Develop recommendations on how findings can inform content strategy.
- Explore how LLM-era language analysis can support web content decisions.
- Collaborate closely with the paired Program Manager on analysis priorities and outputs.
Required experience
- Proven experience as a Data Scientist working with large-scale datasets.
- Strong experience analyzing unstructured text or language-based data.
- Experience identifying trends, patterns, and intent signals from customer interactions.
- Ability to translate exploratory analysis into structured, actionable insights.
- Experience working with anonymized or sensitive consumer data.
- Familiarity with Azure-based data environments.

- Direct impact on how customer language insights inform content and web strategy.

title: Reddit: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://redditinc.com/
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
About the Role
Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.
You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.
You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.
What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.
Strategic Orchestration & Influence
Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.
Team Leadership
Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.
Hands-On Product Ownership:
Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.
Vendor and Demand Management
Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).
What We're Looking For
8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.
Bonus Points
Experience at a high-growth public technology company
Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models
Why This Role, Why Reddit
Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.
You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

title: Lifecheq: Associate Product Manager (Remote)
description:

About Lifecheq
Lifecheq is transforming financial advice and insurance distribution across emerging markets through our cutting-edge technology platform. As Africa's largest advice platform, we empower over 8,000 financial advisers to deliver holistic, personalised financial planning to the underserved mass affluent market.
Our holistic financial advice platform has achieved remarkable results in driving record adviser productivity for our partners. Backed by leading investors, we're expanding across Africa and Southeast Asia – with a mission to create one million sustainable middle-income jobs for financial advisers.
The Opportunity
Own the execution of initiatives that drive adviser productivity - moving more advisers from the mid band into the productive band, and keeping productive advisers there.
What You'll Do

Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the adviser productivity funnel - know how many advisers are in each band, what is moving them up, and where they are getting stuck.
Develop and maintain a view of your key metrics and build instrumentation into the products you manage so you have an ongoing view of performance; know when a number looks wrong before it is flagged to you.
Gather ongoing feedback from advisers and managers directly; build the observational habits to understand where the pipeline is failing and bring findings to the Group PM with a point of view, not just a summary.
Own the alert and nudge pipeline end to end - template creation, regulatory approval submissions, staging tests, production deployment, and delivery quality - ensuring advisers receive the right recommendations reliably.
Manage rollout logistics for new features: determine sequencing, verify adviser access across branches and regions, and troubleshoot activation issues.

Work with lead engineers to coordinate delivery sequencing, dependencies, and deployment schedules; maintain a well-groomed backlog with clear acceptance criteria and flag risks early with a proposed solution attached.
Take responsibility for the business outcomes of the initiatives you run: if adviser productivity is not moving, understand why and bring a plan to address it.

You have a four-year degree or equivalent

A market-competitive salary

Opportunities to work on impactful projects with leading partners and stakeholders
Career growth within a rapidly scaling organisation
The chance to help shape the future of financial services delivery
We’re a remote-first business, with a setup that optimises for async work

title: BRANDOG Digital: Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Paid Social
description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://www.brandogdigital.com/
Location: Remote (US, Canada or Latin America)
Type: Contract / FTE Equivalent
Start: Immediately
The Role
We're seeking an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own a pod of paid social DTC accounts end to end: strategy, buying, and client relationship. You'll work directly alongside the founders to shape how we grow our clients' businesses and our agency's capabilities, while mentoring junior team members and drawing on them for support. Your primary responsibility will be your pod of accounts, and you will also assist the founders across the business with other clients as needed.
Key Responsibilities
Whole-Business Performance
You evaluate accounts through blended CAC, contribution of paid to total revenue, new-vs-returning mix, and retention signals, and you make day-to-day decisions off real performance. Forecasts are a guide and the actual numbers drive your decision-making. You can explain why platform ROAS alone is a bad compass.
Campaign Strategy & Execution
Develop and own full-funnel paid media strategies across Meta (plus potentially TikTok, Pinterest, and other platforms as needed)
Set monthly targets grounded in the client's actual CPA and funded budget, adjusting as reality comes in
Hands-on platform execution: budget allocation, pacing, scaling, and cutting based on performance and client KPIs
Lead campaign setup, launch, ongoing optimization, and performance analysis across your pod
Analytics & Reporting
Own client-facing performance reporting — translating data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations
Build and maintain advanced dashboards using Google Sheets, Supermetrics, and similar tools
Conduct regular account audits to identify growth and efficiency opportunities
Establish and track KPIs, benchmarks, and forecasting models across accounts
Creative Strategy
Translate revenue goals into a plan for what the creative team needs to produce, and when
Analyze creative performance and use data to inform iteration cycles and testing roadmaps
Build and manage structured A/B testing frameworks across creative
Client & Team Leadership
Serve as a primary point of contact for key client accounts, building trust through proactive communication and strategic guidance
Lead client status calls and strategy presentations with a clear, confident perspective
Deliver difficult news clearly and present paths to a solution
Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Marketing Analysts and junior team members
Collaborate with founders on agency operations, new business pitches, and process improvements
How the Ramp Works
The timeline is quick, but the ramp is structured and gradual — we make sure you're confident before you take over, then expect you to run it day to day, with founders staying involved at the strategic level.
Months 1–2: Take over buying and strategy on your starting pod with founder oversight, shadowing then co-leading client calls.
Months 3–4: Lead calls solo as founders step back to strategic oversight.
We'll know it's working if by month four, your pod runs seamlessly through you, and you're handling day-to-day calls, strategy, and buying.
How We Work
You'll work directly with the founders who've built the systems you'll run. We give you the context, tools, and information you need, then we expect you to be independent and trust you to run with it. You arrive with the paid marketing knowledge, and we help you sharpen how you apply it.
We have a defined way of operating — performance-led planning, a structured creative cadence, specific views on measurement — refined across years of DTC accounts. The best people we've worked with bring their own judgment and look to understand why our system works the way it does. That combination is what we're hiring for.
Requirements
Several years of hands-on paid media buying on Meta (other platforms a plus) for DTC/e-commerce at meaningful spend, with accounts you can walk through in detail (what you did, why, and what happened)
Proven track record of managing and scaling paid media budgets with measurable results
Fluency in whole-business marketing math: blended CAC, paid contribution to overall revenue, new-vs-returning dynamics
Client-facing maturity: you can carry a strategy call, deliver difficult news, and build trust over time
Self-directed: you take direction and apply it independently, and you surface problems early instead of sitting on them
Strong command of analytics platforms and experience building data dashboards
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously with the ability to prioritize effectively under pressure
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and motivate junior team members
Available across the full US business day; if US-based, must contract through your own business entity
Familiarity with TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, and other social platforms is a plus
Compensation
Competitive for senior operators, calibrated to experience and location.

Email your resume to jobs@brandogdigital.com with a cover letter outlining your experience managing performance marketing campaigns and any notable results you've driven for clients or brands.

title: Justworks: International Consultant, APAC
description:
Headquarters: Remote - International
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are a strategic advisor and a jurisdictional expert with a proven track record of helping global customers navigate high-stakes complexities in the APAC region. You are consultative, proactive, and passionate about turning nuanced challenges into actionable solutions. You are comfortable solving open-ended, high-risk problems and serving as the final authority on complex APAC employment and Employer of Record (EOR) practices. You build trust easily, collaborate across teams, and advocate for customers while strategically mitigating risk for the business.
As an International Consultant, you are the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for Justworks’ international customers. While the Support Specialist team handles tactical platform navigation and payroll inquiries, you focus on the complex moments—including jurisdictional separation guidance, international benefits strategy, and global regulatory compliance in the APAC region. You own the strategic relationship for customers expanding into diverse international markets, ensuring they maximize the value of Justworks' global offerings while maintaining total compliance.
Your Success Profile
What You Will Work On
Serve as a definitive subject matter expert for EOR services across diverse APAC markets, maintaining deep knowledge of varying regulatory environments.
Act as the primary advisor for complex APAC compliance requirements, providing strategic recommendations on cross-border employment nuances, terminations, and local labor standards to mitigate global risk.
Partner with Legal, Product, and Operations to interpret global industry trends and regulatory shifts, directly influencing international product-market fit and go-to-market strategies.
Partner with Customer Success to manage high-value accounts, addressing sophisticated, territory-specific needs that require advanced jurisdictional expertise.
Act as the final point of internal escalation for inquiries that cross into complex compliance or high-liability HR territory, such as intricate leave scenarios and country-specific benefits.
Proactively identify EOR expansion and upsell opportunities, guiding customers through the strategic complexities of entering and scaling in new international markets.
Drive retention and growth of existing customer base through an education-based approach.
Translate complex international regulations and processes into clear, actionable guidance for customers and internal partners.
Operate independently while contributing to team knowledge and scaling best practices across the organization.
Utilize deep global knowledge to advise customers on legally sensitive and region-specific paths forward.
Serve as the voice of the specialized customer to ensure Justworks’ international infrastructure meets the needs of complex, multinational organizations.
Other duties as needed based on departmental/organizational needs.
How You Will Do Your Work
As an International Consultant, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:
Consultative - Takes an approach that focuses on building relationships with others, understanding their problems, and developing solutions to their challenges through open-ended questions and active listening.
Taking responsibility - Being accountable, being committed, and accepting ownership for one's decisions, actions, and behavior.
Adaptability - The ability to adjust your approach or actions in response to changes in your internal and external environment.
Solution-oriented - Identifies the source of a question or challenge and provides the right, or a better, way of doing things.
Curious - The innate desire to learn, grow and understand.
In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:
Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

title: Porkbun: Content Creator & Video Producer
description:

It's time to hire another amazing individual again. You could be the pick of the litter! Are you the kind of creator who instinctively knows why one video gets 5 million views while another gets 50? Do you get excited about writing hooks, telling stories, and making domain names — yes, domain names — unexpectedly entertaining? Then please read on and apply!
Porkbun is a fully remote domain name registrar. We're looking to add a U.S.-based, full-time Content Creator & Video Producer. We are hiring from within the United States, with a preference for candidates in or around Portland, Oregon, since IRL team collaboration is encouraged.
From .com to .pizza to .plumbing, Porkbun sells more than 500 domain extensions directly to consumers. Our no-nonsense interface and super-affordable prices mean we're adding new customers at a fantastic rate. We've become the go-to registrar for tech-savvy individuals such as developers, while bargain-hunters are thrilled to learn that we offer incredible support despite our industry-low prices.
We've spent years getting really good at buying attention. Now we want to build something more valuable: our own audience — and this role owns that. Porkbun has a uniquely committed and interested fan-base, and we know that our brand is well-positioned to share content that new and existing customers stop scrolling for.
What you'll do:
You'll own video content on organic channels from concept to publication — brainstorming ideas, writing scripts and hooks, filming (cameras, phones, mics, screen recordings), starring or creative casting, editing short- and long-form video, designing thumbnails and titles, publishing, and reading the numbers the next morning so the next one is better. One great idea shouldn't become one video: you'll turn a single concept into YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Reels, LinkedIn posts, newsletter and landing-page content, product-education videos, customer and founder interviews, and registry partner campaign assets. You’ll create both polished, educational knowledge base infotainment and scrappier organic social content that carries the brand’s unique personality.
You'll work closely with the marketing team to publish and optimize content, collaborate with creators and influencers, and support partner campaigns. You'll continually explore and experiment with emerging AI tools for ideation, editing, animation, voiceovers, localization, and video production, helping us discover new ways to create better content more efficiently.
Your work will span everything from short-form social videos and longer educational content to customer interviews, product explainers, behind-the-scenes stories, and creative campaign assets. As this is a brand-new role, you'll have the opportunity to grow our content strategy in a new direction. As you succeed, you will be positioned to lead and hire a team to start turning this giant personal responsibility list into a super team within the marketing department.
Success won't be measured by views alone. We'll measure it by your ability to build our audience, strengthen the Porkbun brand, create content people genuinely enjoy, and help move our marketing forward.
Important skills and experience:
• A portfolio that shows your work and potential
• Strong instincts for brand stories and engaging content
• Comfort with the full pipeline: ideation, filming, editing, publishing, and analysis
• Fluency in both short-form social content and longer educational / infotainment formats
• You edit “one more version” because you know it'll be better, and you know AI makes creative people more versatile, not less relevant
Bonus points for experience with any of: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, Canva, motion graphics or animation, photography, podcast production, YouTube SEO, creator partnerships, marketing tech or SaaS, and AI tools like Runway, Veo, ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, or ElevenLabs.
If the above describes you, or you can make a strong case for why we should hire you anyway, please follow the instructions below EXACTLY and respond accurately — failure to do so means we will filter out your application.
• Attach your resume as a .pdf and include links to your portfolio, website, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or anywhere else you've created content
• Address your email with the subject line “Content Creator & Video Producer”
• Begin your email body by copying, pasting, and responding to the qualifying questions below. If you answer NO, we're sorry, but you are not eligible for the role:
Are you based in the USA and eligible for employment (Yes/No)?
Do you have a portfolio or body of content work you can share (Yes/No)?
• Even better than a written intro: record a quick video telling us why you'd be a great fit. We are, after all, hiring a creator.
• Send that email to careers@porkbun.com
Starting pay: $60,000/year + benefits. Applicants with multiple years of notable professional experience creating video and social content are eligible for a higher starting salary.
This position offers full medical, dental, and vision benefits (single) starting after 90 days, and 50% medical insurance contribution for family or spousal benefits, and a Simple IRA plan with a matching 3% company contribution after the first year. It also includes paid parental leave, two weeks of paid vacation to start, paid federal holidays plus bonus days around Thanksgiving and Christmas, and a budget for creative tools and professional development.

title: Stripe: Staff Product Manager, Cards Monetization
description:
Headquarters: Seattle, San Francisco, New York, US - Remote
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Cards team at Stripe is responsible for the infrastructure, user facing features, and business of accepting credit, debit, and pre-paid card payments. Delivering the best offering for processing credit, debit, and prepaid cards is critical to Stripe’s mission, given the central role card payments play in internet commerce.
What you’ll do
As a Staff Product Manager for Cards Monetization at Stripe, you’ll be responsible for pricing Card payment products worldwide. Everyday - You’ll balance the needs of our customers and competitive landscape, while helping Stripe maintain its margins.
At Stripe, Product Managers help build innovative payments products for our customers. Product development is an extremely collaborative effort between engineering, design, analytics, operations and customer-facing teams. You’d be joining a team of experienced Product Managers who have a track record of successfully building large-scale business and consumer products that are collectively impacting millions of users around the world.
This strategically critical role offers significant exposure to Stripe's leadership as you will drive initiatives to create observability into Stripe’s margins and revenue realization on Cards, define pricing principles and streamline pricing operations. Working with Sales teams, you’ll build out B2B pricing stack, ensuring we automate bundling and discounting decisions. Finally, you’ll work backwards from merchants to define and deliver new pricing models that meet the needs of their growing businesses.
This is a highly cross-functional role - On a day to day basis, you will spend your time between meeting customers (both internal and external), and working with your engineering, operations, analytics, network partnership, pricing, finance and GTM counterparts. You will use the voice of the customers, go deep into data, and leverage ML/GenAI as you define pricing strategies and build margin and revenue monitoring and alerting systems.
In short, you’ll own business growth through pricing optimization. Unsurprisingly, your decisions will have millions of dollars of impact to Stripe’s business.
Responsibilities
Lead Card IC+ pricing/product. Launch Stripe’s IC+ pricing on Cards in new geos and grow adoption with enterprise users.
Ensure we enable GTM teams with the right tools and cost assumptions to streamline sales and customer success processes for IC+ product.
Lead Cards Monetization for Stripe. You’ll be defining what Stripe charges for card transactions worldwide. You’ll define pricing principles, drive pricing decisions and operationalize those decisions working with pricing, finance, marketing and GTM teams.
To effectively set prices, you’ll work with engineering and data science to build observability into current pricing, margin and revenue realization. You’ll drive insights, and translate those into pricing recommendations.
You’ll define processes for competitive analysis and regular pricing audits. Over time, you’ll work with engineering and data science to automate pricing processes.
You’ll research best practices pricing automation (such as algorithmic bundling and discounting), and build out an end to end B2B pricing automation stack at Stripe.
You’ll work backwards from customers, and keep a keen eye on competitors to identify new pricing models. You’ll build the business case, find ways to test, and if validated, work across the company to launch the new pricing models.
On a daily basis, you’ll work with various stakeholders across the organization, including Engineering, Design, Data Science, GTM, Pricing, Marketing, PMs and Operations to drive flawless execution on product and pricing initiatives.
Ultimately, you’ll co-own revenue growth and margin improvements for Cards business through IC+ launches and pricing improvements.
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
10+ years of experience in a product role
Deep understanding of B2B GTM, Pricing and Contracting processes and tools
Ability to effectively collaborate with engineering, product, data science, and cross-functional teams.
Experience working with go-to-market teams in a B2B sales environment.
Experience in B2B Pricing/Monetization
Ability to deeply analyze data, derive insights, and make data-driven decisions. Proven track record of instrumenting and measuring product initiatives, including those with less obvious metrics.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for simplifying complex concepts
Proven successes in delivering continuous product improvement as well as 0 ->1 launches
Ownership mindset and persistence to work on whatever it takes to ensure that your product is successful
Proven ability to deliver high-impact presentations to executive audiences.
Has the ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility
Preferred qualifications
Prior background in Strategy Consulting and/or Finance
Prior experience of building data observability platforms
Experience in Payments, working with Card Networks or Banking partners.
Experience working with ML, data science and data analyst teams. SQL proficiency will help.

Our Risk & Compliance team is hiring a Senior Dispute Analyst to own and continuously improve the full disputes lifecycle at Lithic: intake, investigation, chargeback processing, and resolution. You will own the SOPs that govern each stage, the metrics that measure them, and the process improvements that keep the program defensible to our partner banks, the card networks, and regulators.
This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic investigation tooling across the disputes lifecycle, and this role owns the build: testing, deployment, and ongoing tuning of those agentic solutions so that routine, documented volume is absorbed by automation while you own the complex, judgment-heavy exceptions the tooling escalates. You will be the person who converts tooling into realized capacity through context documentation, skill orchestration, and training. This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and exception handling rather than steady-state queue processing.
What You’ll Do:
Own the end-to-end disputes lifecycle: intake, investigation, chargeback processing, and dispute resolution.
Author, maintain, and continuously improve the dispute SOPs across every stage, ensuring content reflects current consumer protection regulations, network dispute rules, and operational realities.
Test, deploy, and tune agentic investigation solutions across the disputes workflow, including skill orchestration, arbitration automation, and automation tuning, to compress per-case handling time without sacrificing quality.
Document investigative context and develop the skills and prompts that allow agentic tooling to handle routine filing, statement generation, and representment volume.
Handle complex dispute scenarios, edge cases, and pre-arbitration and arbitration exceptions where outcomes depend on judgment and argumentation.
Develop and optimize representment strategies; analyze dispute trends to identify root causes and drive process improvements.
Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the disputes program, and produce actionable insights by synthesizing operational trends and program performance data.
Serve as the interface to any business process outsourcing relationship
Partner with Product and Engineering to frame dispute requirements as enablers and to inform the roadmap for investigation tooling.
Mentor junior analysts and contribute to training on dispute handling, chargeback processing, and the investigation tooling.
What You'll Need:
Deep, hands-on experience managing card disputes and chargebacks, with strong knowledge of consumer protection regulations and card network dispute rules across the chargeback and representment lifecycle.
A track record of owning discrete risk or operations programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.
Demonstrated judgment on complex disputes, edge cases, and pre-arbitration and arbitration scenarios.
Comfort building, testing, and tuning automation or AI-assisted workflows, or strong enthusiasm to own agentic tooling and translate it into operational capacity.
Strong analytical skills: able to synthesize operational and program performance data into trends, root cause analysis, and actionable insight.
Excellent communication with internal stakeholders, partner banks, and, where relevant, regulators, with the ability to frame requirements as enablers rather than blockers.
A bias toward ownership and iterative improvement, and the judgment to know which cases automation should close and which require a human
Nice to Have
Experience at a fintech, card issuer, processor, or sponsor bank.
Familiarity with dispute and case management tooling and with SQL for dispute trend analysis.
Experience standing up or tuning agentic or LLM-based investigation workflows.
Experience managing a BPO or outsourced operations relationship.

Commuter benefit

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
About the Role
We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.
As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.
We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. What You Can Expect
Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.
A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.
What We Are Looking For
7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.
In This Role, You Will
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.
How You Work
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.
About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.
What you will do
Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.
What we are looking for
A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.
How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.
What the role offers
A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.
