title: Galileo: Medical Licensing Specialist (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States
About Us
Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.
About the Role
We're looking for a Medical Licensing Specialist to own the end-to-end state licensing process for our provider population across all 50 states. You'll manage the full licensing lifecycle for Registered Nurses (RNs), Nurse Practitioners (NPs), MDs, and DOs, coordinating directly with state medical boards, providers, and internal teams to keep our clinicians compliant and practice-ready. The role requires knowledge in state-specific licensing requirements, a high degree of organizational precision, and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
This is a full-time, contract position at 40 hours/week, reporting into the Senior Manager, Licensing and Credentialing.
Here’s what you’ll do:
Manage initial state license applications for RNs, NPs, MDs, and DOs across all 50 states, owning each application from submission through approval
Coordinate directly with providers to collect required documentation, including primary source verifications, CEU records, and background checks
Communicate with state medical and nursing boards to resolve application issues, answer inquiries, and expedite approvals where possible
Maintain current, working knowledge of state-specific licensure requirements, processing timelines, and regulatory changes
Use Verifiable to manage provider profiles, track license statuses, and generate compliance reporting for internal stakeholders
Ensure all licensing data is accurately entered and maintained in the credentialing system of record
Proactively flag and escalate issues to prevent delays in provider readiness, managing an active queue of 60+ licenses at any given time
About You
You are a detail-oriented and process-driven operator who takes ownership of complex, high-volume workflows. You know your way around state medical board requirements and thrive in an environment where precision and follow-through are non-negotiable. You can manage a queue of active applications, prioritize effectively, and communicate clearly with providers, boards, and internal teams alike. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, adapting quickly when requirements shift, and escalating the right things at the right time.
We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:
Minimum of 2 years of experience in healthcare licensing, credentialing, or a closely related field
Hands-on experience processing state licenses for RNs, NPs, MDs, and/or DOs
Familiarity with multi-state licensing requirements and the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)
Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent applications
Exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow-through on deadline-driven tasks
Experience with Verifiable or comparable credentialing platforms (preferred)
Experience in a telehealth, virtual care, or multi-state provider organization (preferred)
Compensation: $25/hour
How We Hire
Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. title: Managing Director Discovery and Insight
description:
About Ted
TED is on a mission to discover and spread ideas that spark imagination, embrace possibility, and catalyze impact. Our organization is devoted to curiosity, reason, wonder, and the pursuit of knowledge â without an agenda. We welcome people from every discipline and culture who seek a deeper understanding of the world and connection with others, and we invite everyone to engage with ideas and activate them in your community.
About The Audacious Project
The Audacious Project is a collaborative funding platform that invites visionary changemakers to imagine their boldest ideas to solve the worldâs most urgent challenges.
Housed at TED, the nonprofit dedicated to the belief that ideas change everything, Audacious works to surface ideas that are breathtakingly ambitious yet achievable and brings together a community of philanthropists to unlock the funding needed to make them real. Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world â visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet.
Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas. Rooted in TED's belief that ideas can come from anywhere, Audacious focuses on the strength of the idea and the team behind it, not a fixed issue area. Funded projects span science, climate, technology, health, social safety net and justice.
Job Description
Role Description
The Managing Director, Discovery and Insight leads Audacious's global search for ambitious ideas and changemakers â finding, testing, and building the case for the ideas and leaders most worth backing each funding cycle. This role owns end-to-end curation, application, and diligence activities, ultimately leading to recommendations for the cohort of finalists selected annually.
The Managing Director's work is centered on: a strategy informed by continuous learning about systems-level impact and Audacious' unique role within it; deep collaboration with applicants, donors, and partners nurtured over time; and leadership of a strong team to sustain the work.
Each year, the Discovery and Insight team conducts a global search to identify nonprofit ideas that are:
Innovative and offer a unique approach to a significant problem with the potential to shift the status quo or the system they operate within
Proximate & Community-Oriented in leadership and decision-making structure (i.e., led by those who intimately understand the problem/opportunity, incorporating impacted communities in decision-making, led by someone who has direct experience in/with the community served)
Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they havenât received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince â have an exciting, breakthrough vision (âinspireâ), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (âconvinceâ)
Key Responsibilities
Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
Develop a âfuture-orientedâ approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
Lead selection and diligence.
Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
Build the recommendation â evidence, rationale, and risks included â that carries an idea into finalist selection
Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholderâs goals, priorities, and aspirations
Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right â building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round
Qualifications
Career and Functional Experience
Essential
A leader who has set strategy in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, and who can hold their own in rooms both with ultra-high net worth individuals and issue experts and with their own team, making consequential decisions grounded in clear principles and with conviction
Strong generalist fluency across geographic, social-change and innovation domains with the maturity and credibility to engage experts across them
Experience building and developing teams, leading change management efforts, and operating through influence across a senior leadership group
Access to, and standing within, networks across the social-change and social-innovation ecosystem
Strongly Preferred
Familiarity with multiple models across the sector â funder-collaborative platforms and other philanthropic sourcing and investment mechanisms
Experience in multinational and culturally diverse organizations
Personal Characteristics / Culture Fit
Strong mission orientation, high integrity leadership, alignment with Audaciousâ values
Creative, team-oriented, and collaborative, willing to pitch in where needed
Intellectually curious; a quick study who stays current on social change and emerging trends in philanthropy, and can lead on ways to evolve our work
Confident without certainty; decisive without rigidity
Judgment to lead through influence rather than ownership
What Success Looks Like
A strategy that evolves as the world does â growing sharper and more grounded cycle over cycle â because someone owns its development and can hold key decisions steady even when stakeholder interests pull in different directions
A clear, evolving sense of what belongs in Audacious's portfolio â built from what selection and diligence have taught, not assumed upfront
A network of donors and partners who stay engaged and where relationships are nurtured from inception, and where trust, learning, and respect are built over time
Recommendations reaching the Executive Director hold up because the diligence, learning, and collaboration behind them are real and rigorous
Additional Information
The deadline to submit an application for the Managing Director, Discovery & Insight role is August 19, 2026, at 11:59 pm EST.
TED Conferences LLC is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We invite all qualified candidates to apply online with their cover letter and resume.

As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.
This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.
Position Overview
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.
We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.
Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.
If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.

Business Operations

Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.

Marketing
Operations

Inventory Management
Events & Corporate Wellness
You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.

Required

Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.
Preferred
Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.
What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.
You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.
You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.
Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.
Compensation & Growth
This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.
The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.
Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.
Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?
At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.
Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.
If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

ARC’One, our manufacturing facility in New Westminster, is home to a team of skilled makers and technicians who bring Arc’teryx products to life. Located near our Design Center, the facility plays an important role in how we prototype, test, refine and manufacture the technical gear we are known for.
Some of our most technically complex products including Alpha SV and new product pilots are built here. The facility also supports ReBIRD repair and renewal programs, helping extend the life of Arc’teryx gear.
This is hands-on, precision work where craftsmanship, problem-solving and continuous improvement come together on the production floor. This is Who We Are .

Meet Your Future Team:
Under the supervision of a Production Supervisor, you’ll partner with 10-12 team members to meet all the quality and efficiency standards in pressing different products.

Will there be Visa support? No
Can this job be hired remote? No

Quality first. You will review, troubleshoot, and repair any quality control issues with the Quality Control Inspector and your Team Leader and/or Supervisor
Evolve is our DNA, you will champion it, and you will partner with your team to identify areas of improvement in order to be better than yesterday
In cross-learning we trust, you will be continually challenged in developing your skills and to be able to help all the production lines, if need it
Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:
By combining your willingness to learn and our continuing Learning & Development Program, you will be able to climb our 9 skill levels. You will master the pressing operations .
Are you our future Press Machine Operator?
You have a minimum of 1-year experience in a fast-paced work environment (eg: manufacturing, food services, hospitality)
Our teams are multicultural so communicating in English is not a problem for you, even if it is not your mother tongue
You are comfortable in labor-intensive work environments. You don't mind standing most of the day and doing repetitive tasks on the machine
Your dexterity is excellent: you want to take advantage of it
Your adaptability and flexibility are your strengths and working in a fast-paced work environment with multiple feedbacks, in the same day, does not scare you
You âthink out of the boxâ: you have this capacity to give your feedback and to propose new ideas

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.
Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.
## Role Overview
We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.
## Key Responsibilities
### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized
## Required Skills & Experience
- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
- Able to work autonomously and independently
- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
- Comfortable working European timezone hours
- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
- Comfortable using AI in workflow
## Nice to Have
- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

title: Andela: Product Designer
description:

Staff Product Designer
About Andela:
At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.
As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.
Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.
Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.
Job Summary:
As the Staff Product Designer, you are a visionary leader who shapes how millions of people experience the future of work. You will tackle Andela’s most ambiguous product challenges, working across high-level business strategy and deep user empathy. You aren't just a "maker"; you are a "shaper" who defines the frameworks, logic, and standards that the rest of the design team follows.
Exceptional Leadership:
As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.
Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.
One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.
Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.
Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.
Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.
Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.
Key Responsibilities:
Experience Architecture: Lead the design of complex, multi-sided marketplace flows. You will be responsible for the "big picture" logic of our Talent Cloud, ensuring seamless transitions between client hiring needs and talent career growth.
Strategic Partnership: Act as a peer to Product and Engineering. You will help define the product roadmap by identifying user-centric opportunities that align with Andela’s commercial goals.
Design Systems Governance: While you aren't writing the code, you are the "Source of Truth" for our design language. You will oversee the evolution of our component library to ensure accessibility, consistency, and a world-class aesthetic.
Data-Informed Innovation: Use qualitative research and quantitative data to validate your hypotheses. You should be comfortable navigating complex data dashboards to find the "why" behind user behavior.
Mentorship & Craft Excellence: Elevate the output of the design team through rigorous design reviews, workshops, and the introduction of new methodologies.
Design Mentorship: Act as a "Force Multiplier." You will lead design sprints, conduct high-level critiques, and mentor Senior Designers to help them reach the next level of their careers.
Requirements:
Experience: 10+ years in Product Design, with a significant track record of delivering high-impact B2B, SaaS, or Marketplace products.
Systems Thinker: You have a deep understanding of how design scales. You can think through edge cases, global localization, and complex state management without needing to see it in code first.
Communication: Mastery of the "pitch." You can articulate the ROI of design to non-design stakeholders and build consensus across a global, async organization.
Tooling: Expert-level Figma skills, including advanced prototyping, auto-layout, and library management.
Product Sense: You think like a Product Manager. You understand trade-offs, technical constraints, and how to ship "Minimum Viable Products" (MVP) to learn fast.
The Stack: Experience of Figma paired with professional-grade proficiency in React.js, TypeScript, and CSS-in-JS (or Tailwind).
Additional Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
3+ years in a marketplace, platform, or multi-sided network business model
2+ years managing or mentoring direct reports.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Operations, and commercial teams in a remote or distributed organization.
#LI-REMOTE
#LI-RDR

title: Spiralyze: Project Manager
description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
URL: https://www.spiralyze.com/
The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.
Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplines—research, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.
Key Responsibilities
You’ll own three core responsibilities:
Coordination . You’ll manage cross-functional teams of 5–10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea → build → launch → analysis. You’ll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
Strategy & Planning. You’ll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10–20 upcoming experiments. You’ll communicate the “why” behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.
Energy (“Vibes”). You’re the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.
Skills, Knowledge and Traits
You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Here’s what we need from you:
Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and don’t stop until things are finished properly.
Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.
Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or don’t. You’re the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.
What You’ll Get
Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles.
Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? We’ll help.
In-demand skills. You’ll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.
Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.
If you’re excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Versapay: Senior Product Manager, Payments
description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)
About Versapay
Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
How you’ll make an impact here – and on your career:
Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments , you will own the end-to-end payments product and experience , from customer-facing workflows through underlying processing, settlement, and partner integrations.
In this role, you will be accountable for the vision, strategy, and delivery of our payments capabilities, with a particular focus on our payment processing gateway and broader payments ecosystem. You will operate with a holistic mindset—owning outcomes across reliability, usability, scalability, and commercial performance—rather than isolated features.
This role pairs deep payments domain ownership with modern product management practices. You will lead end-to-end product development, drive customer and business value through data-informed decisions, and collaborate across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative payments experiences. You will also regularly represent the payments product strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment decisions.
This is an opportunity for a product leader who thrives in complexity, is energized by ambiguity, and is excited to help grow and modernize a global payments platform.
What you'll do:
Product Strategy & Vision
Own and articulate a clear product vision and strategy for payments, aligned with company objectives and growth plans.
Take a holistic view of the end-to-end payments experience, ensuring customer, operational, and platform considerations are tightly integrated.
Define and evolve the payments roadmap, balancing customer needs, regulatory requirements, operational scalability, and commercial outcomes.
Stay current on industry trends, emerging payment methods, and competitive offerings to inform strategy and prioritization.
Identify opportunities for cross-product alignment, standardization, and platform unification across the broader product portfolio.
End-to-End Product Ownership
Lead payments products through the full product development lifecycle, from discovery and ideation through launch and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with engineering and design to translate customer problems into well-defined requirements, epics, and user stories.
Prioritize the product backlog based on customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility.
Drive high-quality execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining a strong bias toward action
Payments Domain Leadership
Serve as the subject-matter expert for payments, including payment gateways, processors, payment facilitators, settlement, and funding flows.
Own integrations and relationships with major processors and partners (e.g., Adyen , Fiserv, Global Payments).
Ensure products are built with a strong understanding of payments operations, risk, compliance, and scalability.
Help shape the future of our payments infrastructure to support global growth.
Customer & Market Insight
Be the expert on the customer: deeply understand who is using our payments products, what problems they are trying to solve, and how success is measured.
Conduct market research, customer interviews, and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate solutions.
Design hypotheses and experiments to test assumptions and drive learning.
Data-Driven Decision Making
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success across adoption, revenue, reliability, and customer outcomes.
Use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to inform prioritization and identify areas for improvement.
Present product strategy, progress, and performance to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence
Lead and influence cross-functional teams across engineering, design, sales, marketing, professional services, and customer success.
Act as the primary point of contact for payments products, aligning internal teams and external partners around shared goals.
Facilitate agile ceremonies and ensure teams are focused on delivering the highest-impact outcomes.
Go-To-Market & Adoption
Partner with go-to-market teams to define value propositions, pricing inputs, and launch strategies for payments capabilities.
Create internal and customer-facing documentation, training materials, and presentations to support successful launches.
Drive adoption and ongoing success of payments products post-launch.
Leadership & Craft Excellence
Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture focused on customer value and continuous improvement.
Mentor and influence other product managers, helping elevate the craft of product management across the organization.
Operate effectively in a complex environment, making timely decisions while managing tradeoffs.

title: PressW: UX Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States
URL: http://pressw.ai
About PressW
PressW is where some of the world's most ambitious companies come to actually ship AI.
We're redefining how businesses harness AI by building real systems for real clients, not just selling slides about what's possible. We're a team of three exited AI founders and a group of Applied AI Engineers based in Austin, and we've been heads-down for the last few years building this firm into something we're proud of: more than 70 production AI solutions shipped, 40+ clients across seven industries, and over $50M in measurable profit gains delivered. We work on the bleeding edge of what AI can do, guide our clients to the right solutions for their business, and ship the infrastructure they run on.
We sell across three divisions. Managed AI is our MSP, purpose-built for institutional investors: private equity firms, venture capital funds, asset managers, and capital markets clients. We map how a firm actually works, deploy custom agents into the workflows that consume deal teams' time (reading deal documents, drafting IC memos, scoring targets, triaging inbound, structuring offers, monitoring portfolio companies), and keep evolving those systems as models and firm needs change. AI Engineering embeds our teams directly with clients to build and harden production AI systems. AI Transformation handles roadmap and readiness work, helping leaders figure out what to build, in what order, and how to prepare for it.
Job Description
You will own the user experience for PressW's healthcare scheduling platform rebuild (codename Phoenix), reporting to Engineering Leadership. The platform serves hundreds of thousands of workers across mobile and web, plus an admin interface used by 1,000+ healthcare facilities. Every user-facing surface is being rebuilt from scratch, and you are the person who determines what the new experience looks and feels like.
This role starts before any frontend code is written. Your first months are research: auditing the existing platform's workflows, understanding where users struggle (template management is the #1 pain point and the top churn driver), and conducting customer research with the client's product and CS teams. That research directly informs the API design for each service group and the frontend architecture. By the time frontend engineering begins (~week 20-24), you have months of research behind the design system and component library you're handing off.
Responsibilities
Lead internal platform audit and customer research (Phases 0-2). Map existing workflows, pain points, and user patterns. Work directly with the client's product and customer success teams to understand what needs to change and why.
Provide API design input during backend service group migrations (Phase 3). The REST API shapes should reflect how users actually work, not just how the database is structured.
Design the complete user experience across two frontend batches: worker-facing (schedule viewing, shift pickup, messaging, push notifications) and admin-facing (template management, schedule building, reporting, compliance). The admin batch is where the platform's NPS moves.
Build and maintain the design system and component library. Establish patterns for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA target), responsive design, and consistency across web and mobile.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Conduct usability testing to validate decisions before and during rollout.
Participate in frontend rollout feedback: usability testing with real users during wave rollouts, synthesizing feedback, and iterating on the design.
Present research findings and design decisions in weekly UX reviews with the Frontend Lead and client product team.
Qualifications
Strong UX design experience with both web and mobile applications.
Experience conducting user research and translating findings into product design decisions.
Experience designing for complex, workflow-heavy applications (scheduling, operations, admin tooling, or similar).
Experience with legacy system transformation: understanding existing workflows well enough to redesign them without losing what works.
Ability to design for systems involving APIs and data integrations, with an understanding of how backend structure impacts UX decisions.
Proficiency with Figma or similar design tools.
Strong communication skills. You will present research findings and defend design decisions to both engineers and client stakeholders.
Must have shipped meaningful design work in the last 2 years.
Preferred
Healthcare or regulated-environment design experience.
Design system and component library ownership.
Accessibility (WCAG) expertise.
Comfort with AI design tooling for quick iteration and prototyping.
Experience working in cross-functional teams alongside engineers on active builds.
Why Join PressW
You own the user experience end-to-end for a platform that hundreds of thousands of people use daily. Research through rollout, two apps, two audiences. Small team, high autonomy, real stakes.
PressW is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Please note that only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview. Thank you for your interest in PressW!
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pressw-ux-designer

title: Customer.io: Director, Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Americas Remote
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . I'm looking for an experienced engineering leader to own several of Customer.io 's product development engineering teams. This is a role for someone whose primary job is business impact: you set clear goals, hold teams accountable to schedules, and personally drive complex initiatives to done. Your first mandate is a high-priority, executive-visible platform initiative — the kind of project where you'll set the direction, align the org, and carry it across the finish line yourself. If you're energized by making things happen inside an organization — not just managing the people who do — this role is for you.
About Customer.io
Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.
We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.
What We Value
Execution above all
Leading a team and driving impact are not the same job — yours is the second one, and the team is how you do it. You set direction, create accountability, and see initiatives through across an organization. When something must ship, you put it on your back.
Engineering leaders who go deep and wide
You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align executives on a roadmap and earn an engineering team's respect in the same day. You still read the code, join the incident channel, and know why the thing is late. You don't choose between vision and execution — you hold both.
A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"
You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait.
An AI-first engineering mindset
AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You've developed a real point of view on AI-native development, you can speak to it concretely, and you bring it into how your org operates.
What You'll Do
Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for major platform initiatives — starting with the delivery of our new billing platform, a high-visibility integration program spanning Engineering, Product, and Finance
Set clear goals and delivery milestones, hold teams accountable to them, and communicate progress crisply to executive stakeholders
Make build-vs-buy and sequencing decisions with conviction, and lead the team through them
Mentor and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders — with the bar that everyone on the team can articulate the impact they're driving
Drive a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the org
Leverage AI tools to accelerate team velocity and bring an AI-native perspective to how the team builds
What We're Looking For
12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time leading engineering teams
Experience managing engineering managers and/or senior technical leaders
A track record of driving complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion — you've taken something ambiguous and org-spanning and personally made it ship
Deep understanding of SaaS software architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that come with building in-house vs. buying and integrating
Ability to translate technical complexity into clear strategy and communicate effectively with both engineers and executives
Demonstrated AI-native leadership — not just personal fluency, but a track record of bringing AI-first development practices into how your team works
Comfort operating in ambiguity and making difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities

title: TrainBrainSpace: Expert AI Trainers in Coding, Finance & Accounting, and Medicine/Nursing
description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, AZ.
URL: https://trainbrain.space/
What if the work you already do every day — shipping code, closing books, reading charts — became the training signal that teaches frontier AI how to think in your field?
TrainBrain builds expert-authored training data and evaluations for AI labs. We're hiring practising professionals to write, solve, and grade the tasks advanced models are measured against. When a model returns a broken function, a wrong reconciliation, or an unsafe clinical suggestion, it's because no expert caught it during training. You'd be that expert.
This isn't your day job in a new wrapper. There are no clients, no month-end close, no tickets, no on-call. You work in writing, on your own schedule, on problems chosen to sit right at the edge of what current models can handle.
No AI background required — we train you on the tooling.
Track 1 — Software Engineering
Write, debug, and optimise code across languages and problem domains. Review AI-generated solutions for correctness, security, and performance, and design edge cases that expose model weaknesses. Provide structured feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't — and compare competing solutions on engineering quality.
You'll need:
Advanced proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, Go, or Rust
A solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
A CS degree or equivalent professional experience
Nice to have:
Open-source contributions or competitive programming
Distributed systems, cloud, or DevOps background
Code review, technical writing, or mentoring experience
Track 2 — Finance & Accounting
Author reconciliation scenarios: payment-to-invoice matching, billing versus recognised revenue, margin and variance analysis. Build the underlying data and source documents so each scenario is realistic, write rubrics specifying exact figures and required reasoning steps, then solve every task yourself to confirm the numbers hold.
You'll need:
Hands-on experience as an accountant, financial analyst, controller, or auditor
Working knowledge of revenue recognition, matching principles, and standard close workflows
Comfort with financial documents, spreadsheets, and accounting system outputs
Nice to have:
CPA, CA, ACCA, CIMA, or CFA
IFRS or US GAAP depth
ERP familiarity (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks)
Audit, financial controls, or revenue assurance background
Track 3 — Medical & Clinical
Challenge models on differential diagnosis, drug interactions, treatment protocols, pathophysiology, and evidence appraisal. Write clinical vignettes with defensible, sourced answers, verify model outputs against current evidence, and document precisely where reasoning breaks down.
You'll need:
An MD, DO, MBBS, PharmD, RN/BSN, or advanced health sciences degree
Real clinical or research experience
Command of medical terminology and clinical reasoning
Nice to have:
Board certification or active licensure
A specialty focus (internal medicine, oncology, psychiatry, emergency medicine, radiology, nursing practice)
Peer-reviewed publications
Clinical trial, epidemiology, or medical education experience
What the work demands
Whatever your track, four things matter more than anything else.
Show your work. Making your reasoning explicit matters as much as the answer itself.
Be verifiable. Every task you write needs a correct answer someone else can confirm.
Iterate. You'll refine tasks until difficulty and gradability are both right.
Flag uncertainty. Saying "I'm not sure, and here's why" is a feature, not a failure.
You'll also need excellent written English, sharp attention to detail, and a secure computer with reliable internet.
Terms
This is a 1099 independent contractor position, not W-2 employment. You're responsible for your own taxes, and company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance, PTO, and retirement contributions don't apply. Contractors outside the US are engaged under the equivalent local arrangement.
Pay: $45–$100/hr, set by domain, seniority, and assessment performance. Specialised and hard-to-source expertise sits at the top of the band, and you're paid on a regular cadence.
Schedule: Choose your own projects, hours, and volume. Scale up in quiet weeks, scale down when your day job gets busy.
Growth: Strong contributors are invited into higher-rate specialist projects and review roles, with ongoing work as new engagements launch.

title: Dropbox: Director, Product Design
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations
Role Description
Dropbox’s Design team is looking for a Director of Product Design to define the next generation of product experiences and infrastructure for Dropbox. In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for the systems, patterns, and operating model that shape how Dropbox builds coherent, high quality, multi product experiences at scale.
We are building a modern system that can support a broader portfolio of products, accelerate product teams to achieve product market fit, improve front end quality, and create durable patterns for the most important product experiences across Dropbox. You will lead the team responsible for turning repeated product needs into reusable experience infrastructure: interaction patterns, product frameworks, design primitives, implementation standards, and adoption models that make it easier for teams to build excellent Dropbox experiences.
As Director, you will oversee the evolution of Dropbox’s design system into a next generation design and technology platform. This includes the foundational system of components, tokens, accessibility standards, and documentation, but also the broader lifecycle of product patterns: how they are identified, designed, validated, built, adopted, measured, improved, and eventually deprecated. You will help move the team from a reactive model, where design systems patternize work after the fact, to a more proactive model, where the team helps shape core product experiences from the beginning.
You will also establish Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality. This team should not only define what good looks like, but help build it. That means partnering deeply with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, brand, and leadership to create high leverage patterns that improve product coherence, accelerate execution, and raise the quality bar across web, mobile, desktop, and emerging AI native experiences.
The ideal candidate is a systems minded design leader with excellent product judgment, strong craft standards, deep experience leading multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to operate across strategy, execution, governance, and organizational influence. You should be equally comfortable defining a long term vision for the future of design systems, reviewing the details of a complex interaction pattern, partnering with engineering on implementation quality, and helping senior leaders understand where the product experience needs stronger horizontal investment.
This is a critical leadership role for Dropbox’s multi product future. You will help define how shared product experiences are built, how teams adopt them, how quality scales, and how Dropbox creates a more coherent, intelligent, and durable product experience for customers.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the vision for Dropbox’s next generation design system, expanding it from a component library into a broader product experience platform for patterns, primitives, standards, and shared product logic.
Lead Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality, interaction patterns, accessibility, implementation standards, and cross product experience coherence.
Build and evolve reusable product patterns that drive core Dropbox experiences, including navigation, creation flows, sharing, permissions, collaboration, onboarding, search, content activation, notifications, settings, admin workflows, and AI assisted experiences.
Move the team from reactive patternization to proactive product leadership, helping identify horizontal product needs early and shaping solutions that can scale across multiple Dropbox surfaces and teams.
Own the full lifecycle of shared patterns and components, including discovery, definition, design, prototyping, engineering partnership, adoption, measurement, maintenance, governance, and deprecation.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing, and Design leadership to align on the highest impact horizontal opportunities and ensure shared systems directly support product strategy.
Raise the craft and quality bar across Dropbox by improving interaction design, visual quality, information architecture, accessibility, motion, content patterns, implementation fidelity, and front end consistency.
Create an operating model that makes adoption desirable rather than mandated, ensuring product teams see the system as a way to move faster, build better, and reduce duplicated effort.
Lead and develop a team of designers, design technologists, and systems specialists, creating clear ownership, strong critique practices, high standards, and a culture of pragmatic systems thinking.
Partner with engineering leadership to improve the relationship between design systems, code, product infrastructure, and front end delivery, ensuring that design intent is translated into high quality implementation.
Establish durable governance, measurement, and contribution models that help the system evolve continuously while maintaining quality, coherence, and accountability.
Help Dropbox prepare for AI native product experiences by defining systems that can encode design knowledge, guide product decisions, and support more adaptive, contextual, and intelligent experiences over time.
Requirements
12+ years of product design, design systems, design technology, or front end experience, including significant experience leading complex systems or platform initiatives at scale.
5+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of leading senior designers, managers, design technologists, or multidisciplinary systems teams.
Deep experience building, scaling, or transforming design systems for complex multi product organizations.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect systems work directly to customer value, product strategy, execution speed, and business impact.
Exceptional systems thinking, with the ability to see patterns across teams, products, platforms, and workflows, then turn those patterns into reusable experience infrastructure.
High craft standards across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, prototyping, content patterns, motion, and implementation quality.
Proven ability to influence senior cross functional partners, create alignment across ambiguous problem spaces, and drive horizontal product quality without relying on mandate alone.
Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering with front end engineering teams on component architecture, implementation standards, platform constraints, quality control, and system adoption.
Experience defining governance models, contribution models, quality standards, documentation practices, and lifecycle processes for shared product systems.
A clear point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, design infrastructure, and reusable product logic should change how teams design and build.
A collaborative, low ego leadership style, with a track record of developing talent, raising standards, improving critique, and helping teams produce better work than they could have produced on their own.
A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong design leadership, systems strategy, product impact, organizational influence, and excellent taste.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading design systems, design technology, front end platform, or product infrastructure teams in a large scale, multi product organization.
Deep understanding of how to leverage content systems as part and parcel of the overall design system.
Experience building shared patterns for complex product domains such as collaboration, content management, permissions, search, productivity, AI, administration, or multi product ecosystems.
Strong technical fluency across coded systems, design tokens, component architecture, accessibility infrastructure, prototyping tools, and front end implementation quality.
A strong point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, and reusable product logic should evolve the way teams design and build.

title: Caspar Health: Junior Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten)
description:

Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

Messbarer Impact:In den ersten 3-6 Monaten baust du ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Patient:innen auf, definierst klare Erfolgskriterien und bringst erste Features oder Optimierungen live, die spürbare Verbesserungen Nutzungsverhalten zeigen
Your profile
Erste PM-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits in agilen Teams gearbeitet und dabei geholfen, nutzerzentrierte digitale Produkte zum Erfolg zu führen
Leidenschaft fürs Bauen & neue Technologien: Du liebst es, Dinge einfach auszuprobieren – ob durch Prototyping, Experimente oder „Vibe Coding“. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools und Automatisierung ganz natürlich als Hebel, um schneller zu validieren und smarte Lösungen zu bauen

title: Better Proposals: Junior SEO Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Brighton, UK
URL: https://betterproposals.io/
Are you “the one”?
We're looking for a Junior SEO Specialist to join our growth team. You’ll work directly with the Growth Manager and help with everything SEO related, from keyword research and internal linking to technical SEO, content planning and link building.
This is a junior role, but not a trainee position. You should already understand the basics, know your way around the usual SEO tools and be ready to work on a real website.
You will not be expected to know everything. You will be expected to learn as much as possible and figure things out.
What does the job look like?
The role covers most areas of SEO, including:
Researching keywords and identifying new opportunities
Reviewing existing pages and recommending improvements
Finding and implementing internal linking opportunities
Creating content briefs and proposing new pages
Monitoring rankings, traffic and organic conversions
Using Google Search Console to investigate performance and indexing
Crawling the website with Screaming Frog
Using Ahrefs for keyword, competitor, content and backlink research
Finding and qualifying link building prospects
Running outreach campaigns and following up with contacts
Tracking new links and reporting on campaign performance
Identifying common technical SEO issues
Creating and checking structured data
Improving page titles, descriptions, headings and on-page content
Helping us track GEO, AIO and AI search visibility
You will not do every one of these things every day, and you will not be the only one on the team. Don’t have experience with all of these? Don’t worry.
Some weeks will be more focused on content. Others might involve technical checks, outreach or improving pages that are already performing well.
What we’re looking for
You should already understand:
The basics of technical, on-page and off-page SEO
How to do keyword research
How to assess search intent
How internal linking works
The basics of link building and outreach
How to use Google Search Console
How to use the main reports in Ahrefs
How to crawl and inspect a website with Screaming Frog
What schema and structured data are
How to use AI tools to work faster without trusting everything they produce
You do not need to be an expert in every area.
We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals, can follow a process and is willing to figure stuff out when they don’t immediately understand them.
You should also be comfortable working independently. You will get direction and feedback and someone will always be there for you. But we are not interested in micro management.
Nice to have
It would be useful if you have experience with any of the following:
SaaS SEO
WordPress or another CMS
Basic HTML
Writing content briefs
Link building outreach
SEO reporting and analytics
GEO, AIO or optimisation for AI search tools
Experience with GEO or AIO is welcome, but not required.
Nobody has ten years of GEO experience. A genuine interest in learning about it is enough.
Benefits
Salary dependent on experience and what you can bring to the role. We use Glassdoor as a guide for your location and pay above average.
Remote work in a global company, with a friendly and hardworking team
Opportunity to grow within the company, and earn promotions and pay rises
No work on your birthday
3 weeks paid holiday + 1 week for every year (capped at 6 weeks)
Choose 8 national holidays that make sense to your country.
Annual bonus based on personal performance
Our AI policy
We don’t hate AI, but we NEVER use AI tools to produce customer facing content. Our customer support is not AI based, you always have a live person to talk to. Our articles are not AI written slop, but real opinions and expertise of real people. We want it to stay that way.
Using AI tools for keyword research, data analytics and process improvements is cool. Posting what ChatGPT spits out and passing it as a blog article is a fireable offence!
Next steps
Assuming everything goes well, here’s how our hiring process goes:
You apply
We have an initial interview
We will have a 2nd interview
In special cases we might have a quick 3rd call to clarify a few things, but mostly not.
We offer you the job
You’re expected to accept it within 1 business day.
Application deadline: Friday 28th August 2026

title: Harney & Sons Fine Teas: Associate – ERP Operations (SAP Business One)
description:
Headquarters: Millerton, NY
URL: https://www.harney.com
About the role
Harney & Sons has been making and selling fine tea from Millerton, New York for over four decades. We are family-owned, we are growing, and we run our business through a single ERP system: tea production and blending, direct-store-delivery truck distribution, a Shopify storefront, and wholesale accounts across the country and overseas.
This role sits at the center of that. You will work inside SAP Business One to build the processes, reports, and tools the business runs on, and you will learn how tea gets blended, packed, loaded onto a truck, and delivered.
A meaningful share of the work is hands-on building. Our systems have to talk to each other — the ERP, the storefront, the shipping and distribution side — and the automations that connect them need someone who can write the queries and scripts behind them and prove they actually work.
You will report directly to the Director of ERP and Manufacturing Operations. The team is small, so your work is visible and you will see the results of what you build.
What you will do
Develop and maintain processes in SAP Business One to support and streamline business operations..
Build, test, and maintain automated workflows and integrations that move data between SAP Business One and the other systems in the tech stack, including writing the SQL and scripts they depend on.
Continually validate results of queries, workflows, dashboards, and other automations to ensure that business decisions are being made with accurate information.
Analyze operational data to surface trends and track down anomalies, then explain what you found.
Spot gaps and friction in operations and proactively develop tech-driven solutions to streamline processes.
Create reports and dashboards for increased business insights, while tracking adoption and end-user usage.
Train end users, write the documentation, and measure adoption rates.
Learn the Harney & Sons operation (production, distribution, ecommerce, and wholesale) well enough to spot problems before anyone files a ticket.
When we work with outside implementation consultants, document requirements, track deliverables, and flag slippage early.
Write clear progress updates and brief the departments affected by what you are building.
Who we are looking for
You like taking apart how something works and figuring out why it breaks.
You thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative work environment.
You have already outgrown spreadsheets for the harder problems and reach for code when it is the better tool.
You have strong communication skills and can communicate technical information in simple terms.
You follow through: a small improvement that actually ships beats a big plan that never does.
You can proactively spot and address errors and inefficiencies.
You do not trust your own output until you have tested it. You care about data being right, and about keeping it secure.
A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business, accounting, supply chain, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
Technical skills we need
SQL. You can write joins and aggregations, read someone else’s query, and work out why a result set has the wrong row count. You do not need to be a database administrator.
Scripting, ideally Python. Enough to read, modify, and debug a script that transforms data or calls an API, and enough appetite to write your own from scratch.
APIs. A working understanding of requests and responses, authentication, pagination, and what happens when a call fails halfway through a batch.
A testing instinct. When you build something that moves data, you should already be wondering how you would prove it moved the data correctly.
Helpful, but not required
ERP exposure. Any system counts: SAP Business One, NetSuite, Dynamics, Acumatica, Epicor, or even a warehouse or accounting system you had to bend to your will.
Integration or workflow automation platforms. Any low-code tool where you assemble a data flow visually but still write the logic and the queries underneath it.
SAP Business One Service Layer or DI API, or any ERP’s API for reading and writing records programmatically.
Reporting tools. Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Crystal Reports or SAP Business One Query Manager.
Manufacturing, food and beverage, or distribution experience, particularly anything involving lot codes, expiration dating, or traceability.
