title: Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy
description:
About ShatterproofShatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life. Through evidence-based programs, advocacy, and public education, Shatterproof works to transform systems for tomorrow, support families today, and end stigma forever. Learn more at shatterproof.org.
Who Succeeds at Shatterproof
Shatterproof is in a period of transformative and rapid growth. We are building new systems, reimagining how work gets done, and creating more cross-functional alignment to accelerate our mission.
To thrive here, you should be energized by building, not just maintaining, and excited to bring structure, clarity, and innovation to evolving spaces.
We're looking for team members who:
Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale.
Take ownership and act with a builder's mindset, bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for direction.
Influence and collaborate across teams, shaping work through strong communication and relationship-building.
Move quickly, learn fast, and adapt with resilience, especially in a high-growth, high-impact environment.
Are mission-driven and motivated to leave their mark on an organization working to reverse the addiction crisis.
The RoleReporting to the Chief Financial & Administrative Officer, the Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy serves as Shatterproof's senior technology executive and leads the organization's technology, digital operations, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, enterprise applications, digital platforms, and technology-enabled products.
This leader will create and execute a comprehensive technology vision that advances organizational strategy, enables operational excellence, strengthens security and resilience, improves the employee experience, supports fundraising and advocacy, and drives innovation across mission-focused platforms.
This role is ideal for a builder who wants the rare opportunity to shape not only an organization's technology strategy, but also how technology, data, AI, and digital platforms accelerate mission impact at scale.
The Team
The Vice President leads a multidisciplinary team spanning enterprise technology, digital operations, data, and product management. Current direct reports and functional oversight areas include IT Operations, Digital Operations, enterprise CRM and database capabilities, Treatment Atlas Product Management, and Treatment Atlas Data Management. The role is responsible for developing these capabilities into a cohesive, high-performing technology function that provides exceptional organizational support while advancing Shatterproof's digital, data, and platform strategy.
The team supports and manages a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology and workplace operations, cybersecurity and privacy, Salesforce and enterprise applications, website and fundraising technology, business intelligence and reporting, artificial intelligence initiatives, and the current and future technology architecture supporting Treatment Atlas.
In addition to leading the internal team, the Vice President oversees a network of managed service providers, software vendors, implementation partners, and technology consultants, ensuring that internal and external resources are aligned to organizational priorities and positioned to scale with Shatterproof's evolving needs. This includes stewardship of strategic technology platforms and vendor relationships that support operations, fundraising, advocacy, data management, and mission delivery. Key ResponsibilitiesEnterprise Technology Leadership & Strategy
Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology investments, risks, innovation opportunities, and emerging trends.
Establish technology governance, architecture standards, prioritization practices, and a transparent enterprise roadmap.
Evaluate and guide major technology investments, platform strategies, sourcing decisions, and vendor partnerships.
Ensure technology decisions support mission impact, operational effectiveness, sustainability, and growth.
AI Strategy & Digital Innovation
Lead Shatterproof's enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
Establish governance frameworks, risk controls, and responsible-use standards for AI technologies.
Identify and prioritize AI use cases across fundraising, operations, impact programs, and administration.
Lead tool evaluation, pilots, implementation planning, adoption, training, and change management.
Monitor emerging technologies and assess opportunities to create measurable organizational value.
IT Operations & Workplace Technology
Lead IT and workplace technology operations for a distributed workforce.
Oversee managed service providers, help desk operations, devices, Microsoft 365, identity and access, collaboration tools, and general application administration.
Ensure timely and secure onboarding, offboarding, access management, and technology provisioning.
Maintain service standards, knowledge management, policies, procedures, and documentation.
Continuously improve reliability, support quality, and the employee technology experience.
Cybersecurity, Privacy & Organizational Resilience
Lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy, policies, governance, and training.
Oversee risk assessments, incident response, cyber insurance requirements, Keeper governance, backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Partner with leaders to protect organizational, employee, donor, constituent, and program data.
Monitor emerging risks and drive practical, prioritized mitigation plans.
Digital Platforms, Website & Fundraising Technology
Lead the strategy, governance, performance, accessibility, analytics, and integrations for Shatterproof's website and digital engagement ecosystem.
Oversee fundraising and advocacy technologies, including DonorDrive and New Mode, and related digital vendors.
Partner with Development, Marketing & Communications, and Public Affairs to strengthen constituent experience, engagement, and platform value.
Oversee Google Analytics and related reporting and optimization capabilities.
Salesforce & Enterprise Applications
Own the enterprise Salesforce roadmap and governance framework.
Oversee administration, security, permissions, data quality, integrations, reporting, releases, user support, and adoption.
Partner with department leaders to prioritize enhancements, automation, workflow improvements, and reporting needs.
Ensure enterprise applications remain aligned with operational and strategic priorities.
Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence
Establish organization-wide data governance, reporting standards, and stewardship practices.
Oversee dashboards, data models, access, refreshes, data quality, and Power BI capabilities.
Partner with leaders to improve data-informed decision-making and performance visibility.
Build scalable, well-governed analytics and reporting capabilities.
Treatment Atlas Platform & Product Leadership
Serve as technology executive sponsor for Treatment Atlas in close partnership with Impact leadership.
Oversee current processing infrastructure, operational monitoring, troubleshooting, releases, integrations, data flows, and vendor coordination.
Lead the reimagined platform product and technical roadmap, delivery oversight, architecture, cloud strategy, security, and implementation partners.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, usability, and long-term sustainability.
Technology Financial Management & Vendor Strategy
Develop and manage the annual technology budget, forecasts, and multi-year investment plans.
Oversee invoices, purchasing, contracts, renewals, licensing, and license optimization.
Lead major vendor decisions, negotiations, performance management, and strategic relationships.
Develop clear business cases and recommendations for significant technology investments.
Oversee the purpose, vendor relationship, users, integrations, renewals, support, and roadmap for Just5, and manage the LegitScript relationship, certifications, submissions, renewals, and organizational obligations.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology and digital operations team.
Create clarity around roles, decision rights, service ownership, priorities, and cross-functional ways of working.
Assess future capability, capacity, structure, and sourcing needs.
Build a culture grounded in accountability, service, collaboration, innovation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Communicate complex technology issues in accessible, business-oriented language and lead change with transparency.
Ideal Experience & Qualifications
12+ years of progressive leadership experience spanning technology, digital operations, enterprise systems, product management, data, cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
Experience serving as the senior technology leader for a complex organization and developing enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organizational capability.
Strong experience with cybersecurity, technology governance, privacy-supporting controls, risk management, and organizational resilience.
Experience leading CRM, data, analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and major technology implementations.
Experience overseeing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendor relationships, and implementation partners.
Experience introducing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, governance, adoption, and training.
Ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, and execution plans.
Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Ability to operate effectively in a mission-driven, distributed, and evolving environment.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
Deep alignment with Shatterproof's mission and values.
CompensationThe salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000. Placement within the range is determined by experience, internal equity, and organizational budget.
Additional Information
Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
Domestic travel may be required based on organizational needs.
Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

title: COSTING ENGINEER
description:
Role Summary
The Costing Engineer â Jigs & Fixtures is responsible for the end-to-end financial estimation of specialized tooling required for electronic assembly lines. This role involves analyzing technical drawings, calculating manufacturing costs for custom parts, and budgeting for complex automation components. The goal is to provide accurate "Should-Cost" models that ensure high-quality assembly solutions are delivered within budget.
Core Responsibilities
Component & Material Estimation
Fabricated Parts: Calculate costs for metallic (Al, SS) and non-metallic (ESD plastics, Delrin) parts by evaluating material weight, machining cycles (CNC/VMC), and finishing processes.
Bought-Out Items: Source and maintain price benchmarks for:
Mechanical: Bearings, linear rails, and precision slide ways.
Pneumatics: Cylinders, DCV valves, and manifold systems.
Automation: PLCs, sensors (proximity/optical), magnets, and HMI units.
Electrical: Push buttons, switches, wiring harnesses, and connectors.
Assembly & Validation Costing
Estimate man-hours for mechanical assembly, pneumatic plumbing, and electrical wiring.
Factor in costs for fixture testing, calibration, and $Cpk/Ppk$ validation runs.
Strategic Financial Analysis
Conduct Make vs. Buy analyses for custom fixture components.
Perform Value Engineering (VA/VE) to suggest lower-cost alternatives for non-critical parts without sacrificing precision or safety.
Maintain a live database of vendor quotes and historical cost data.
Technical Requirements
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Production Engineering.
Experience: 3â5 years in costing, specifically within high-precision tooling or electronics assembly.
Software Proficiency: * Advanced MS Excel (Macro/Pivot tables) and ERP systems (SAP/Oracle).
Ability to view and measure parts using CAD software (SolidWorks/AutoCAD).
Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of milling, turning, grinding, and surface treatments.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
Estimation Accuracy: Variance between estimated cost and actual procurement cost.
Turnaround Time: Speed of providing quotes for new assembly line projects.
Cost Savings: Success in identifying 5-10 %$ annual savings through Value Engineering.
BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
High attention to detail (zero-error mindset).
Strong negotiation skills for dealing with external vendors.
Ability to collaborate effectively between Design, Procurement, and Finance teams.

title: Maintenance Planner
description:
Job Purpose
We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. In this role, you will be responsible for effectively planning, preparing, and scheduling maintenance activities to support equipment reliability, maximize plant availability, and reduce unplanned downtime. You will work closely with the Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Spare Parts teams to ensure maintenance activities are prioritized, properly resourced, and executed safely and on time.
Responsibilities:
Plans, prepares, and schedules maintenance work orders to ensure they are completed safely, on time, and in full (OTIF).
Reviews and prioritizes maintenance work requests based on risk, equipment criticality, and reliability.
Prepares work orders by defining the required scope, tasks, resources, materials, and tools.
Schedules maintenance activities considering equipment criticality, planned downtime windows, and availability of parts and services.
Coordinates with the Spare Parts Coordinator, Storekeeper, Procurement, and Maintenance Execution teams to ensure required materials and tools are available.
Manages maintenance task lists and ensures required materials are requested in line with inventory and supply processes.
Ensures accurate and timely registration and management of maintenance information within the CMMS.
Supports preventive maintenance planning and contributes to the preparation of maintenance budgets.
Supports TPM and continuous improvement activities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reliability, and plant availability.
Works closely with maintenance stakeholders to improve planning efficiency, reduce downtime, and support reliable execution of maintenance activities.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Knowledge & Experience:
2â5 years of experience in maintenance planning, operations, supply chain, or a reliability-focused role.
Experience in maintenance planning, preparation, and scheduling.
Good understanding of supply and inventory management processes.
Experience working with a CMMS and/or maintenance planning and scheduling software.
Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities.
Good reporting, data handling, and basic computer skills.
Understanding of workflow management and maintenance work prioritization.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Supply Chain.
Experience with TPM, reliability, or continuous improvement practices is an asset.
Application Closing Date: August 28, 2026

title: Face Deduplication Collection
description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.
The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:
• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.
• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.
• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.
To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

title: Message Center Operator
description:
Amentum is seeking a Message Center Operator to support the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas . AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. The Message Center Operator is responsible for maintaining strict accountability for Local Element CMS/EKMS and other associated classified materials, records, and equipment in the Communications Message Center. They will also be responsible for receiving, processing, and distributing incoming and outgoing Naval and civilian message traffic for the AUTEC project. Proficiency in loading classified material utilizing electronic devices and adherence to stringent COMSEC procedures.

Report equipment malfunctions to appropriate technical and management personnel.

Perform other duties as assigned, required or directed.
Qualifications:
High school graduate/equivalent or better.
3-5 years related experience working in a communications computer media environment.
Military Message Center/EKMS experience desired and preferred.
Ability to pass Message Center Communications Qualifications requirements within 60 days of hire.
Maintain and sustain training and level of knowledge requirements in associated administrative and limited technical disciplines.
Adapt to a rotating shift schedule (12-hour increments).
Maintain a consistent high standard of professionalism with customers and coworkers.
Able to follow a structured chain of command.
Demonstration of consistently excellent customer service skills required.
Occasionally lift/pull/push up to and including 40 pounds of office supplies.
Frequently exposed to circuit noise and periodic alarms in the Message Center.
Knowledgeable in Microsoft Windows 10 or later and MS Outlook. (Skill in Word, PowerPoint, Excel a plus)
Consistently demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills.
This position requires the individual to be eligible to obtain a US Government security clearance; US Citizenship is required

A valid US Passport and Driverâs License is required.

title: Recognizing the Friction
description:
Virtual works adequately for many meetings. But how big is the gap between adequate and optimal for any given meeting? The mode decision should weigh the meeting's importance against the friction of meeting in person â not default to either one.
tClara
survey of 522 US-based business leaders, including 95 C-suite respondents
Across 26 meeting goals, 43% of leaders rate in-person as the better mode, 35% say virtual, and 22% say mode barely matters â the decision is genuinely goal-dependent, not a fixed rule.
In-person is the preferred mode for 22 of 26 goals â especially building trust and teamwork, persuading or selling, and solving important problems.
Virtual is preferred for goals like gathering diverse opinions, sharing updates, and using people's time efficiently.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.
We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.
Duties
· Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients
· Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success
· Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required
· Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.
· Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines
· Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues
· Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management
· Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment
· Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices
· Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives
Our Technology Stack
· Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA
· Documentation – Hudu
· RMM – Intune / Immybot
· Networking – Meraki
· Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365
· Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon
· Door Access – Avigilon
Qualification
· 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support
· Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry
· Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service
· Proven experience leading IT projects
· A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications
· Background in providing direct end-user support
· High level of attention to detail
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills
· IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)
· Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents
Our Core Values
Dream Big, Then Make it Real
We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell.
Client Driven Results
Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed.
Own Your Progress
We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.
We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: Background job monitoring
description:
Glossary/
Scheduled Jobs/
Background job monitoring
Scheduled Jobs
Background job monitoring
Background job monitoring is watching asynchronous jobs for timely completion and success signals.
What is background job monitoring?
Background job monitoring describes watching asynchronous jobs for timely completion and success signals. In reliability work, the label is useful only when it maps to a measurable check, a clear owner, and a next action when expectations break. Without that operational meaning, the phrase becomes decoration in dashboards and status updates.
Why it matters
Background job monitoring matters because teams need a precise shared meaning for watching asynchronous jobs for timely completion and success signals. Vague language turns incidents into arguments about words instead of fixes.
When everyone uses the same definition, alerts, status updates, and post-incident reviews stay aligned.
How it works
In practice, watching asynchronous jobs for timely completion and success signals shows up as a concrete signal you can measure or communicate. Operators define what good looks like, watch for deviations, and record what happened when expectations break.
The useful version of background job monitoring is operational: it changes who gets notified, what customers see, or which metric a team reviews after an incident.
Practical example
Imagine a team operating around queue worker heartbeat each minute. When observed behavior stops matching the definition of background job monitoring, the team treats that change as a reliability event with a clear owner and next step.
Common misconception
Background job monitoring requires browser scripting
That reading usually collapses distinct ideas into one slogan. Keep background job monitoring tied to observable behavior so the definition stays useful under pressure.
How Fajita handles this
Use heartbeats or success pings from workers. External HTTP monitors alone may not see queue lag.

title: Resource Manager
description:
Company Description
The Story Shack is a modern, low-overhead creative studio built to scale a brand's story. We give brands the power of an in-house creative team â without the headaches and high costs that plague the industry. We address the broken creative model by offering flexible, budget-friendly, scalable, and specialized solutions for brands.
Role Description
We're on the hunt for a sharp and dependable operator to join our scrappy, fast-growing creative studio and work directly alongside our Head of Community.
As our Resource Manager, you'll be the engine behind the scenes â running talent outreach, supporting creative resourcing, coordinating project needs, and keeping administrative tasks tight and on track. You'll help make sure every project has the right people in place at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks.
You'll also get exposure to the business side of a growing agency â supporting resourcing, budgeting, invoicing, and talent relationships as we continue to grow.
If you've got real experience in the agency, studio, or production world, love staying organized amid creative chaos, and want a front-row seat to how a creative company is actually run, this role was made for you.
Responsibilities
Manage daily tasks with our 300-person creative community, including administrative outreach to freelance talent such as creative directors, copywriters, directors, cinematographers, photographers, producers, designers, and more â including initial outreach, scheduling, and follow-up.
Run availability and rate checks across our talent network for upcoming projects, keeping records accurate and up to date.
Support creative resourcing with Project Managers, Account Managers, and Producers by helping match the right talent to the right projects based on skill set, client needs, availability, and budget.
Handle financial administration, including invoice monitoring, payment tracking, and flagging discrepancies.
Maintain organized, up-to-date talent and project databases.
Serve as a first point of contact for talent inquiries and applications, while helping build and maintain strong relationships across our creative community.
Qualifications
Experience in a creative agency, studio, or production environment with resourcing responsibilities.
Outstanding communication and organizational skills.
Comfortable managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
Detail-oriented, especially when it comes to financials and scheduling.
A collaborative, low-ego attitude with the ability to support someone else's workflow and priorities.
Genuine interest in the advertising and film industries and building relationships with creative talent.
Familiarity with talent databases, project management tools, and invoicing/accounting software is a plus.
Existing relationships within the creative production community are a plus.

title: Expression of Interest
description:
Why we exist
We can get food, groceries and rides to our door on demand but accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to sometimes overstretched clinical facilities.
Demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations of how they manage their health have fundamentally changed. That is why Heim exists: to build the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, and make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale.
We surface and optimise unused practitioner availability, then work with healthcare providers to deliver care ranging from blood sample collection to wound dressing, reaching patients where and when they feel most comfortable.
About Us
We're a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare.
Before Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not-for-profit diagnostics provider into the go-to platform for Covid testing during the pandemic, testing over a million patients in under 18 months. Before that, James co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, our Medical Director, is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator.
We've tripled our volume of appointments every period since going live at the end of 2023, and are backed by leading VCs in the space. We now cover 98% of the UK and hold a 4.9/5 patient rating.
Why we're asking
We're a small but mighty team and are growing quickly, which means roles open at short notice and close fast. Rather than lose good people to timing, we'd rather know who you are now. Tell us what you're interested in and we'll come back to you if and when something fits. Weâre building a picture of people across:
Clinical
Product
Technology
Growth & Commercial
Marketing
Operations & Delivery
HR and Finance
What We Look For, Whatever The Role
Extreme ownership and high velocity, paired with a real appreciation for clinical safety in a high-stakes environment
Low-ego collaboration across the whole organisation, engineers, commercial, clinical and implementation alike
Curiosity and initiative. You want to look under the hood, evaluate trade-offs and dig into the data rather than accept the first answer
A belief that there is beauty in simplicity, and a habit of returning to first principles on complex problems
A critical mind that guides the people around you towards clear decisions
Comfort with an unstructured, fast-moving environment, and readiness to be challenged
You never lose sight of the reality faced by nurses and patients out in the community
We're a small team and we get a lot of interest, so unfortunately we won't be able to come back to everyone. Your details stay on file, and if you're a fit for us, we'll be in touch!

Job Context
Aditya Birla Group is India's first truly multinational corporation. A US $65 billion corporation, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. It is anchored by an extraordinary force of over 1,87,000 employees belonging to 41 different nationalities.
Hindalco is one of the leading producers of aluminum and copper. Hindalco ranks among the global top five aluminum majors, as an integrated producer with low-cost alumina and aluminum facilities combined with high-end rolling capabilities and a global footprint in 13 countries. It has a turnover of US$14.8 billion. Hindalco's major products include standard and specialty grade alumina and hydrates, aluminum ingots, billets, wire rods, flat rolled products, extrusions and foil. Some of Hindalcoâs brands include Everlast aluminum roofing sheets, Freshwrapp aluminium foil, Fresh pack, semi-rigid containers, Perma shield, waterproofing, Aluminum foil, Hindalco extrusions, Birla Copper, Birla Gold, Birla Silver
At Hindalco, we have captive Coal and Bauxite mines, located in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and in Maharashtra. We have total 16 MTPA of coal requirement. Hindalco is building coal portfolio of 17-18 MTPA through own mines.
Bandha Coal Mine is a Green Field Project with an annual production plan of 5 MTPA with complete open cast mining. The Mine was allotted to EMMRL in auction process and allocation order received from MOC on 3 rd Mar 2021. The control of EMMRL was taken over by Hindalco Industries Limited from 1 st Dec 2025 through share purchase agreement between EMIL & Hindalco. All statutory clearances required for mining including FC-I, FC-II, EC, and mine opening permission have already been obtained. The mineable reserve is 207 million tons & extractable reserve of 197 million tons.
Major Challenges : -
Availability of skill manpower:-Availability of skilled manpower for drilling & Blasting to achieving targeted production.
Control of absenteeism: - Absenteeism and migration of workforce from day to day work due to difficult and adverse working condition mining.
System availability and integration: - Ensuring integration and availability of all the resources (equipment and latest technology) for drilling & blasting of coal from different working faces over a network of 4 km from different seams of the Mine.
Cost control: - AsMine has been procured at a high price, production at optimum cost with the most efficient use of available resource.
Motivation of work force:- To motivate workforce under adverse industrial and
Economic scenario.

title: Calling Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Thank you for showing interest in Outreach Specialist role at KSNL Consulting LLC! Before we move forward, we want to make sure you have a full picture of what we do and what this job actually looks like day to day.
Who we are : KSNL Consulting is a project consulting firm. Every day, thousands of commercial projects hits the portal we work from â Nature of the projects can be any project from changing a bulb to providing aircraft maintenance project. Our company stick to the practical, everyday services: commercial cleaning, landscaping, transportation, roof replacement, electrical, plumbing, and others like it. Our job is to match those projects with the right vendors and manage everything in between.
Your job : You'd be the person making that match happen. Here's how it works â we hand you a project summary with the location, frequency, required certificates, insurance, and materials. You take that summary, put it in your own words, and explain it to vendors over calls and texts. And here's the best part: you're not selling them anything. You're offering them business for work they already do.
On every first call, you'll need to do three things: explain the project, collect the vendor's cell number and business email, and lock in their site visit appointment. That contact info matters â all our follow-ups happen over text, and you'll follow up with each vendor at least 4 times.
The numbers : This is a high-volume outbound call role. You'll be making 150â200 calls a day, plus reaching out to project managers and contracting officers.
If that sounds like something you'd thrive in and you have the proficient in English Communication, then follow the STEPS.
STEP#1: Please send us a at least ONE MINUTE VOICE NOTE explaining your academic and professional accomplishments. Also do tell us about your journey. Also give us a good reason why you think you are the best candidate for this position. WhatsApp number +17032204299
STEP#2: Complete the Application Form and Trial Task given in this form ( follow the instructions ). and mail at ksnl.federal@gmail.com
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1f32l5IiqhfqALYLH6gHwVBPHsDEdxyEZ67K-099xcW0/preview
STEP#3: Setup an interview call on CALENDLY by clicking this link . https://calendly.com/humanresource-ksnl/30min
FEW THINGS TO KEEP IN MIND
1. You will be connected on zoom, sharing your screen for the time allocated to work.
2. Your mic shall be UNMUTED at all times during 10 Hour working hours. 60 min of Break
3. NO BACKGROUND NOISE due to the fact THAT YOU WILL BE WORKING IN A GROUP SETTING AND CALLING VENDORS
4. This is a FULL TIME POSITION . No other job will be allowed .
Qualifications
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
Experience in outboarding calling to North American and European Clients.
Experience in detailing high call volume approximately 150 - 200.
Able to understand complex project and explain in simple words.
Able to talk convincingly with the vendors and able to persuade the vendor for site survey.

title: Join Praemium Expression of Interest
description:
We hire dynamically at Praemium!
At Praemium, we use the Expression of Interest as a way of connecting with people that have an interest in working with us. Candidates simply submit their details to be matched to future role at Praemium.
Whatâs an Expression of Interest?
If we have no specific jobs advertising in the location and area you are interested in working in, you can submit an Expression of Interest, which contains information about you, your job preferences, and your availability. Youâll then be added to our candidate pool, where youâll be considered for opportunities and contacted if a job youâre matched to becomes available. No more scrolling our Careers website regularly to check for new jobs â weâll let you know if you match a job near you!
If you are matched to a job you'll be invited to check out the details and confirm you interest and availability for the job - you'll always have the choice to decline.
Improving your "matchability"
Our system matches candidates based on suitability for a specific job. To maximise your chances of being matched, we suggest when completing the Expression of Interest you consider each question carefully and include the broadest preferences based on what is relevant for you.
Check back on Praemium Careers from time to time
Finally, while we do use the Expression of Interest option, we still advertise roles our current opportunities and rely on this as a central recruitment source. So, itâs worth taking a look at our Careers website from time-to-time.

title: Nanny Camp Hill
description:
Full-time Nanny, Camp Hill (40-hours), Commence ASAP!
Hours: MondayâFriday, approx. 40hrs per week (6amâ2pm) | Permanent Full-Time (4-day week may be considered for the right candidate)
Salary: From $70,000 + super + entitlements
Minis: Two boys, 4 & 2, with a baby girl due in November
Commence: ASAP
About Our Clients
This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. Dad is a busy business owner, while Mum is a stay-at-home mum preparing to welcome their third mini later this year. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.
Their boys are active, curious and full of laughter, enjoying swimming lessons, music, park adventures and playing with monster trucks. The family embraces a healthy lifestyle with limited screen time and loves outdoor play and learning through everyday experiences.
Duties
Sole charge of the minis when required
Planning fun, engaging outings and activities
Taking the minis to swimming, music and other social activities
Preparing healthy meals for the minis
Light household duties including kitchen tidying, dishes, rubbish and general wipe-downs
Driving the minis to activities using the family vehicle
Supporting the smooth running of the household during busy mornings
The perfect fit
You're reliable, adaptable and personable, with a genuine passion for supporting young families. You are known to be a nanny who is respectful and not overbearing and follows family routine whilst being confident working independently while respecting the family's routines and parenting style.
All you need is minimum 3-yrs professional childcare and or nanny experience, a valid Blue Card, police check, first aid/CPR certification and a current driver's licence. Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds trust naturally, communicates openly and enjoys creating a calm, fun and nurturing environment where children can thrive.
What's in it for you?
Become a genuinely valued and trusted member of a warm family
A supportive, respectful workplace where you'll be appreciated
Long-term, permanent employment providing stability and consistency
A nanny car for your job
Competitive salary plus superannuation and full entitlements
Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with three wonderful children as the family grows
If you have always dreamed about becoming a professional nanny with a natural gift bonding with children, we'd love to hear from you!
Apply Now
Hit Apply , or send your updated resume and introduction outlining why you'd be the perfect fit to hello@miniconnections.com.au . Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

At Downer we plan, create and sustain. Downer is the leading provider of integrated services in Australia and New Zealand. Through trusted relationships and world leading insight we work closely with our customers to design, build and sustain assets, infrastructure, and facilities.

Laboratory testing of asphalt and construction materials

Current P Licence minimum
A positive attitude and willingness to learn

Willingness to work outdoors and travel to project sites
Previous construction materials testing experience is advantageous but not essential
What's on offer:
Competitive hourly rate
Full training provided
Ongoing development and nationally recognised qualifications
Day and night shift opportunities
Supportive team environment
Long-term career opportunities within Downer

Pre-employment medical & physical assessment
Drug and alcohol testing
Ongoing compliance with Downer's Zero Harm safety standards
Reference Number: 735122

title: HR Assistant Payroll & Benefits
description:
At Total Care Connections , our mission is to enrich lives by providing compassionate, high-quality home care that empowers individuals to live safely and independently. We believe that exceptional care begins with supporting the dedicated employees who make our mission possible. As a Payroll and Benefits Assistant, you play an essential role in ensuring our team members are paid accurately, have access to the benefits they need, and receive the timely support that helps them feel valued . Your attention to detail and commitment to service directly contribute to a positive employee experience, allowing our caregivers and staff to focus on delivering outstanding care to those we serve.
Position Summary
The HR Assistant supports the Payroll & Benefits Department by processing and validating employee information that feeds payroll and benefits administration. Serving as the first checkpoint in the payroll process, this role helps ensure employee changes are complete, accurate, approved, and submitted on time.
Key Responsibilities
Payroll and Employee Data Support
Validate time and attendance, PTO, leave, and employee records before each payroll cycle.
Process approved new hire, termination, compensation, transfer, promotion, and leave-of-absence changes.
Enter approved benefits deduction changes and maintain supporting documentation.
Conduct routine employee data audits, correct inaccuracies, and escalate unresolved discrepancies before payroll deadlines.
Provide the Payroll and Benefits Specialists with complete and accurate information for each processing cycle.
Employee Lifecycle And Benefits Support
Support onboarding and separation processes, including employee record setup, benefits eligibility, access-removal coordination, and required benefits continuation notifications.
Track benefits eligibility and enrollment milestones and maintain applicable eligibility lists.
Prepare employment verification letters and other routine employee correspondence.
Respond to general employee questions and escalate payroll or benefits concerns as appropriate.
International Payroll Support
Review international time and attendance records and support employee and contractor payment readiness.
Identify absences, unpaid time, missing information, and other payroll-impacting discrepancies before applicable deadlines.
Qualifications
One to two years of experience in HR administration, payroll support, benefits administration, or a related role.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and comfort working within recurring deadlines.
Experience using HR, payroll, benefits, timekeeping, or employee data-management systems.
Ability to handle confidential employee, payroll, and benefits information with discretion.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately.
Strong written communication skills and comfort supporting U.S. and international team members.
If our mission resonates with you and you're passionate about supporting the employees who make our care possible, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
We are seeking a Social Media Strategist to build and grow a personality-led social media presence from the ground up.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role covering strategy, account setup, content planning, production management, publishing, audience growth, community management, and performance optimization across Instagram and TikTok. You will work closely with the founder to establish a distinctive online identity and develop it into a recognizable, highly engaging social presence.
Responsibilities
Build and launch the Instagram and TikTok profiles from zero, including positioning, tone of voice, content pillars, visual direction, and channel strategy
Develop and execute the organic growth strategy, with a focus on reach, engagement, follower growth, and long-term audience development
Create viral campaign concepts, social-first stories, and repeatable content formats that establish a distinctive and recognizable online personality
Manage the full content lifecycle, including research, ideation, scripting, content calendars, production coordination, approvals, publishing, and optimization
Use platform analytics, audience insights, watch time, retention, and engagement data to guide creative decisions and improve performance
Manage day-to-day community engagement and coordinate with the founder and creative partners
Requirements
Proven experience launching and organically growing Instagram and TikTok accounts from an early or zero-follower stage
A strong portfolio of high-performing, viral, or culturally relevant social content supported by measurable growth results
Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, audience behavior, retention, discoverability, engagement, and organic growth mechanics
Strong creative strategy and social-first storytelling skills, with the ability to turn a personality into compelling and repeatable content
Hands-on experience managing social media end to end, from strategy and content development through production, publishing, analytics, and community management
Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with the founder and creative production partners
Able to work PST hours
Nice to Have
Experience working with creator-led brands, founders, entertainment properties, personality-driven accounts, legal brands, or character-led content is advantageous but not required

title: Ingenious.build: Senior Product Designer
description:

Joining INGENIOUS.BUILD means embarking on an incredible journey to create the first cloud application for managing the entire lifecycle of a real estate construction project. You'll be building what some consider the holy grail of construction project management. It's a big, bold, and audacious endeavor, and if you have what it takes, you'll play a direct role in its development.
And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll be directly involved in its development. The rest, as they say, will be history...

title: Maven Clinic: Design Lead, Consumer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA; Remote, US
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com
An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:
TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
Fortune Change the World (2024)
CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.
About the role
We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.
What we’re looking for
You may be a strong fit if you have:
7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.
A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.
Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.
Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.
A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.
We’d especially love to see
Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.
Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.
Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.
Location and working model
This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.
The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.
Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.
Benefits That Work For You
Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:
Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting
These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.
Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com .

description:
Headquarters: EMEA Remote
About Customer.io
Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.
About the role
Hi, I'm Matt Lane, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I'm looking for an Account Manager to join our EMEA team. This is a revenue ownership role — you'll manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts, driving renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and building the kind of relationships that make customers want to grow with us. You'll be part of a tight-knit EMEA team and a key commercial voice for the accounts you own.
This role is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland only.
What we value
Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is
Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel
Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion
Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers
Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff
What you'll do
Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation
Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly
Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology
Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor
Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals
Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward

3+ years in Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred)
Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space
Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation
A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own
Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards
Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Based in the UK or Ireland
Compensation & Benefits
We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $80,500 base + $34,500 variable = $115,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.
We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.
See full benefits here →

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

Take-Home Assignment
1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team

title: RETR: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://retr.app/
Why this role matters now
A loan officer's business runs on relationships. Ours runs on making sure RETR never gets in the way of theirs.
When something breaks for a customer, a real deal is on the line, and what they need is a person who understands both the product and their business. That person is you.
Most support jobs are a treadmill: you answer the question, the question comes back, you answer it again. Here the work compounds. A good answer becomes an article, the article teaches our AI, and the question stops coming. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, so you can watch the queue shrink because of something you wrote.
What you'll do
• Be the first human a customer talks to, across email, chat, and phone, for individual and enterprise accounts alike
• Answer the hard half. Our AI handles the routine questions; what reaches you is the ambiguous, the technical, and the high-stakes
• Write and improve the knowledge base articles that make the AI better and the queue smaller. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, and we fix the ones that fail
• Build real fluency in mortgage and real estate workflows, deep enough to explain our product in the customer's language rather than ours
• Take actions that carry weight: refunds, cancellations, and billing corrections in Stripe
• Surface product friction to Engineering with enough evidence that it gets fixed, then tell the customer when it ships
• Hand inbound leads to Sales cleanly. Support does not sell, but Support is often the first to touch a future enterprise deal
The first 90 days
Two things in this job reach customers at scale without a human in between: the knowledge base, which feeds our AI, and our enterprise accounts. A knowledge base article that is 80 percent right makes the AI wrong for everyone who asks. So neither one is handed to you on a calendar date. Both are handed over when you have earned them.
Days 1 to 14. Product and customer mastery. Learn what every search does and why a customer would use it. Read every knowledge source we have. Study the queue, open and closed. Start answering emails and chats.
Days 15 to 30. Triage with ease. Route what you cannot answer to the right place. Start taking phone calls, which demand faster answers than anything written.
Day 30. You can run the inbox alone, handle refunds and cancellations, and walk a customer through troubleshooting without help. You will run a mock demo of the platform with your manager playing the customer.
Day 60. You start owning knowledge base articles. If a customer asks something twice, you write it.
Day 90. Full coverage, including enterprise, to the white-glove standard those customers expect. The test that matters: your manager can be offline for a week and nothing breaks.
We would rather ramp you properly than throw you at enterprise in week three and apologize to a customer for it.
The team
Two people. You report to our Customer Support Manager. She reports to our COO. That is the org.
You will also work directly with Engineering on bugs and escalations, with Customer Enablement on onboarding, and with Sales on inbound leads. We are twelve people. Everyone reaches across.
The stack
• Support. HubSpot for tickets, SLAs, and reporting. Aircall for phone. Stripe for billing.
• AI. An AI agent handling first-line resolution, tuned against a knowledge base you will help own.
• Product. The RETR platform: search, lists, exports, alerts, and enterprise account management.
What we're looking for
• 1 to 3 years in a customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
• Genuine patience and real critical thinking. Most of what reaches you will not have an obvious answer
• You explain the why behind an issue rather than just the fix, because that is what builds trust
• Sharp attention to detail in how you document requests, troubleshooting steps, and interactions, plus the instinct to see a problem before it lands
• You would rather fix the root cause than close the ticket
• Comfort with support tooling and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
• Curiosity about AI as a tool you shape, not a threat you resent. A meaningful part of this job is making the machine better
Bonus. Familiarity with the mortgage or real estate industry, or another regulated and technical field.
How we operate
Three philosophies we run by:
• Give more than you get.
• Lead with value.
• Do the right thing.
Five values behind them: Honesty. Integrity. Fairness. Accountability. Excellence.
You'll love this job if you already operate this way. If you don't, we're not the right fit for you.
“Give more than you get” is the one that shows up most in this job. It is the difference between answering the question a customer asked and answering the question they were actually trying to solve. We may not always be able to go the extra mile, but we can always go the extra inch.
What we offer
• $52,000 to $58,000 base salary. National band, no geo-adjustment
• Fully remote, US-based
• Medical Insurance
• Dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability employer-provided
• 401(k) with match: 100% of your first 1% plus 50% of your next 5%
• 15 days PTO plus 13 paid holidays, including Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving
• $100 weekly meal stipend, $100 monthly wellness stipend
• Full home office setup: laptop, monitors, camera, peripherals provided
What we don't offer
• Big-tech RSUs. We're bootstrapped. No stock grants.
• Bureaucracy. We're small and we like it that way.
• A ticket queue you disappear into. What you learn from customers reaches the people who build the product, in the same week.
• A script to hide behind. Our customers are people building businesses, not numbers in a queue, and we answer them that way.
How to apply
Send a resume and a short note to jobs@retr.app answering one question: tell us about a question you got asked so many times that you did something about it. What did you change, and did it work?
We read every application. If there's a fit, we'll set up a conversation.
We're an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
More at retr.app.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/retr-customer-support-specialist

title: TestGorilla: Senior Demand Generation Manager
description:
Headquarters: Netherlands
URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/careers
✨ Where do we hire from? Find out if we're hiring in your location from hiring at TestGorilla
Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team.
About the role
As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales.
Responsibilities
In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.
Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets.
Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots.
Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor.
Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions.
Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language.
Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins.
What you’ll bring
We're looking for someone who:
Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.
Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment.
Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS.
We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far.
Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager.
Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite.
Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly.
Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use.
Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift.
We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply.
Bonus skills
While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have:
Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution.
Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM.
Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget.
Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels.
Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool
What’s in it for you?
Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process.
Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world
Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs)
Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
* Check out the countries we currently hire from here
Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!
Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities
Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches
Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being
Interested?
At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone!
When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.
We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

Відповідати за весь цикл маркетингової аналітики — від необроблених даних до прийняття рішень
Створювати та масштабувати потоки даних для ефективного маркетингу у всіх платних каналах
Відповідати за маркетингові інформаційні панелі з детальним розбиттям за рекламними матеріалами та джерелами трафіку для відстеження та оптимізації LTV, CAC, ROAS та конверсії у воронці продажів
Розробляти та автоматизувати моделі LTV, аналіз когорт та атрибуцію доходів по всіх каналах
Тісно співпрацювати з маркетинговою командою для оптимізації розподілу бюджету, стратегій масштабування та ефективності каналів
Підтримувати та оцінювати маркетингові експерименти (креативи, воронки, аудиторії, A/B-тести)
Забезпечувати точну атрибуцію та узгодженість даних у всіх точках контакту з маркетингом та продуктом
Що очікуємо від тебе:
2+ роки та більше досвіду роботи на посаді Data Analyst, Data Engineer, або на аналогічній посаді у сфері веб-маркетингу чи аналітики продуктів;
Впевнене практичне володіння мовою SQL та досвід роботи з великими масивами даних;
Глибоке розуміння показників ефективного маркетингу (CAC, LTV, ROAS, термін окупності);
Досвід проведення когортного аналізу, моделювання LTV та прогнозування доходів;
Досвід роботи з Tableau для створення інформаційних панелей та візуалізації даних;
Чому це крута пропозиція?
Повний ownership і широка зона впливу : це роль першої людини у функції, яка матиме реальну відповідальність за напрям і можливість формувати підхід майже з нуля.
Перспектива масштабування команди : у майбутньому ця позиція може вирости в побудову власної аналітичної команди та ролі Ліда.
Готова аналітична інфраструктура : у компанії вже є необхідна база — таблиці, дашборди та налагоджені процеси, тож не доведеться витрачати час на побудову всього з нуля.
Фокус на аналітиці, а не технічному супроводі : за пайплайни даних відповідає окрема команда КМА, тому аналітик не займається дебагінгом, а працює як внутрішній замовник і партнер для бізнесу.
Баланс стартап-динаміки та структури : компанія поєднує гнучкість і швидкість стартапу зі зрілим, добре організованим середовищем.
Вплив на ключові бізнес-рішення : ця роль дає можливість не просто готувати звіти, а безпосередньо впливати на рішення компанії через дані, висновки та інсайти.
Ми пропонуємо:
1. Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).
2. Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформансі: гідна винагорода, що відповідає твоїм скілам та досвіду. А також ми забезпечуємо технікою незалежно від формату роботи та географії.
3. Кар’єрне зростання через дію: 80%+ усіх leads в Kiss My Apps ще 2-3 роки тому були світчерами. Твій вплив тут не визначається роками в резюме — він визначається тим, як швидко ти навчаєшся, береш відповідальність та береш оунершіп за власну карʼєру.
4. Командні активності: Для підтримки ментального здоров’я нашої команди ми пропонуємо онлайн-заняття йогою двічі на тиждень.
5. Розвиток та професійна реалізація: проводимо внутрішні speaking clubs англійською з нейтів спікером, а також надаємо можливість виступати на внутрішніх та зовнішніх івентах від Kiss My Apps. Крім цього ти матимеш річний бюджет на покриття до 50% професійних конференції, освітніх подій та івентів.
6. Додаткові бенефіти, де ти обираєш: надаємо фіксований бюджет на рік з якого ти сам обираєш, яку статтю витрат покрити: 50% від медстрахування, психотерапії, спорту чи стоматології. А також 40 днів оплачуваного відпочинку та лікарняних без привʼязки до дат.
7. Опора в умовах війни: забезпечуємо кожного всім необхідним для безперебійної роботи, системно підтримуємо Сили Оборони та долучаємось до ініціатив із відновлення України.
Важливо: є опція бронювання для військовозобов’язаних після випробувального терміну, за умови наявності належно оформлених військово-облікових документів та внутрішніх можливостей компанії, визначених відповідно до вимог чинного законодавства.
If you want to create creatives that are seen by millions, join us.
Let’s move the future together.
